jobs.title: Quality Assurance Technician 1
jobs.description:
**Forming Our Future together**


FormFactor, Inc. (NASDAQ: FORM), is a leading provider of essential test and measurement technologies along the full semiconductor product life cycle — from characterization, modeling, reliability, and design de\-bug, to qualification and production test. Semiconductor companies rely upon FormFactor’s products and services to accelerate profitability by optimizing device performance and advancing yield knowledge. The company serves customers through its network of facilities in Asia, Europe, and North America.


Rooted in our core values — Focus on the Customer, Ownership \& Accountability, Respectfully \& Effectively Communicate, and Motivate \& Develop People — we foster an environment where diverse perspectives are not only welcomed but celebrated. Everyone can make an impact here. Whether it's improving products, supporting customers, or positively influencing peers and the community, the contributions of our people matter.

**Shift:**


The regular hours for this position are Wednesday, Thursday, Friday and every other Saturday from 6:00pm to 6:15am. You will receive a 15% shift differential for working on the night shift.**Job Description:**


The **Quality Assurance Technician 1** is responsible for performing detailed inspections and quality control activities to ensure products meet internal standards and customer specifications. This role requires strong technical inspection skills, proficiency with microscopes and measurement tools, and the ability to collaborate with engineering and operations teams. The Technician will support both in‑process and final inspection workflows in a fast\-paced manufacturing environment.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**Inspection \& Quality Control**

* Perform detailed defect inspections of advanced probing technology products using the **Olympus MX‑50 microscope** and other precision inspection tools.
* Conduct **in‑process inspections** to verify product quality during various manufacturing stages.
* Complete **finished goods inspections** to ensure all outgoing material meets customer and internal specifications.
* Capture and document high\-quality **inspection images** of components and products.

**Nonconformance Management**

* Identify nonconforming product and generate accurate, timely **nonconformance reports**.
* Partner with engineering teams to support investigations, root cause analysis, and corrective actions related to quality issues.

**Data \& Documentation**

* Validate outgoing product data to ensure compliance with customer requirements.
* Perform accurate **data entry** and maintain up\-to\-date inventory information in the appropriate database systems.
* Follow detailed work instructions, SOPs, and documentation standards to maintain product traceability and compliance.

**Teamwork \& Operational Support**

* Work within a shift\-based team environment to support daily quality, engineering, and production activities.
* Contribute both as a collaborative team member and as an individual contributor to help meet daily inspection and production quotas.
* Follow a **compressed work schedule (3x4\)** as assigned.

**Work Environment \& Physical Requirements:**

* Role may involve frequent standing, repetitive hand motions, and handling small or delicate components.
* Work performed primarily in a clean‑room manufacturing setting, requiring adherence to gowning and contamination‑control procedures.
* May require exposure to chemicals, specialty tools, microscopes, or precision measurement equipment.
* Must follow all required safety protocols, wear appropriate PPE and clean‑room attire (full coverall suit, hairnet, mask, gloves, etc.) for extended periods of time.
* Must be able to lift up to 30 lbs.

**Skills:**

Clean Room Manufacturing, Communication, Computer Literacy, Data Entry, Hand Dexterity, Microscope, Microsoft Office, Problem Solving, Working Independently**Education \& Experience:**

Less than 1 year of related experience. No formal occupational training is typically required \| Required**Pay Range:**


$19\.30 \- $25\.36**Pay Range Explained:**


This role in Livermore, California pays between $19\.30 and $25\.36 per hour, depending on your experience, skills, and background. Pay may vary in other locations. We offer a full benefits package, including medical, dental, vision, life insurance, disability coverage, a 401(k) with company match, employee stock purchase plan (ESPP), and paid time off. You’ll also be eligible for quarterly profit\-sharing bonuses and flexible spending or savings accounts.**Equal Employment Opportunity Statement**


FormFactor is an equal opportunity employer. FormFactor complies with all national, state, and local laws that seek to promote equal opportunities for any applicant or employee without regard to age, race, color, gender, gender identity/expression, national origin, sexual orientation, religion, disability, marital status, pregnancy or related condition, military service, or any other legally protected characteristics. These protections apply to all aspects of employment, including but not limited to, recruitment, hiring, training, promotions, and compensation.

  

For roles that are designated as remote\-eligible, employees cannot be located in: AL, AK, AR, DE, GA, HI, IL, IA, LA, ME, MD, MS, MO, NE, NV, NJ, NM, ND, OK, PA, RI, SC, SD, TN, WV, WI, WY. This list is continuously evolving and being updated, please check back with us if the state you live in is on the exclusion list. A role is remote\-eligible only when it is listed as "Remote" in the job location.

jobs.description:
**Role Title:** Patient Care Coordinator  
**Role Type:** 0\.55 FTE \- Thursday through Saturday  
**Location:** San Jose  
**Manager:** Practice Manager

**About Metropolis Dermatology**

We do derm differently. Our mission at Metropolis Dermatology is to make healthy skin accessible to everyone by providing the highest quality medical and cosmetic dermatology care.  
Metropolis Dermatology is growing rapidly within Los Angeles, with plans to expand our footprint throughout California. We’re looking for passionate, self\-motivated do\-ers to help us execute on our bold mission.

**Our Values**  
● Patients first  
● Accountability, not blame  
● Be compassionate  
● Always be learning  
● Have fun

**About You**

*Must Have*  
● Great oral and written communication skills  
● Self\-motivated and go\-getter attitude  
● Excellent customer service skills  
● Be highly organized with an eye for details  
● Ability to multitask  
● Process orientation  
● Be an enthusiastic team player  
● Like to have fun  
● Ability to work weekdays and Saturdays  
● Proof of adherence to CA state and local healthcare vaccination standards

*Nice\-to\-Have*  
● Prior experience in retail, hospitality or other client\-facing industry  
● Experience in dermatology, aesthetics or skin care  
● Understanding of healthcare insurance basics

jobs.description:
### **Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 5 years of experience in program or project management.
* Experience driving New Product Introduction (NPI) for hardware programs (e.g., PCBA, accelerators, equipment, racks, switches, optics).
* Experience with materials management (e.g., bill of materials (BOMs), contract manufacturers, supplier coordination, delivery material readiness, etc.).

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* 5 years of experience managing cross\-functional or cross\-team projects.
* Hardware supply chain experience driving products from prototype to mass production.
* Experience with supply planning and accounting/finance analytics.
* Ability to collaborate and influence across multiple levels of an organization and experience leading cross functional process improvements, using strong analytical and communication/facilitation skills.

**About the job**
-----------------


A problem isn’t truly solved until it’s solved for all. That’s why Googlers build products that help create opportunities for everyone, whether down the street or across the globe. As a Program Manager at Google, you’ll lead complex, multi\-disciplinary projects from start to finish — working with stakeholders to plan requirements, manage project schedules, identify risks, and communicate clearly with cross\-functional partners across the company. Your projects will often span offices, time zones, and hemispheres. It's your job to coordinate the players and keep them up to date on progress and deadlines.


As Program Manager, you will lead all aspects of supply chain readiness in New Product Introduction (NPI) products for our global data centers. You will work with cross\-functional teams starting with product inception to volume ramp to bring innovative products into global data centers efficiently and dynamically. You will demonstrate domain expertise in material readiness, clear to build, supplier and contract manufacturer management, procurement, manufacturing, supply resiliency, and are well versed in other aspects of operations and engineering that impact supply chain strategies and execution.  

  

In this role, you will be responsible for developing and executing materials plans, enabling prototype builds and driving production ramp plans for products deployed in our data centers. Product types include networking, infrastructure, and server and storage. You will work closely with Engineering, Supply Chain Operations, Supply and Demand Planning, Contract Manufacturing, and Supplier partners to launch new products and to implement processes and systems that directly scale new product deployments.


Behind everything our users see online is the architecture built by the Technical Infrastructure team to keep it running. From developing and maintaining our data centers to building the next generation of Google platforms, we make Google's product portfolio possible. We're proud to be our engineers' engineers and love voiding warranties by taking things apart so we can rebuild them. We keep our networks up and running, ensuring our users have the best and fastest experience possible.


Individual pay is determined by factors including job\-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.
  

  

US: $159000 \- $230000 (USD) \+ 15% bonus target \+ equity \+ benefits  

  

Learn more about benefits at Google.**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Drive material and supply chain readiness for all NPI builds from concept phase to production handoff, partnering with cross\-functional teams to ensure success.
* Identify and communicate supply chain risks and mitigation plans to ensure materials readiness for NPI builds as well as enabling long term supply continuity into production.
* Be the primary materials liaison with ODM/CM/Suppliers, manage spend against project budgets, and drive large production risk buys and strategic buffers.
* Develop and document global supply chain map for each product, including suppliers, procurement model, lead time, shipment logistics, assembly/test/fulfillment model, and spares strategies.
* Update project schedules, communicate status, risks and influence change, and represent the New Product Introduction Supply Chain organization in internal program meetings, driving initiatives and process improvements to help the team grow in scalability.

jobs.title: Differential Response Program Manager
jobs.description:
**AGENCY DESCRIPTION:**

Instituto Familiar de la Raza, Inc. is a multi\-service community health \& social service agency with emphasis in serving the Chicano/Latino/Indigenous community in San Francisco with a special focus on the diverse needs of the Mission District. Services include a wide range of mental health, HIV related services, and social services including health promotion, education, prevention, early intervention, case management, clinical, psychological and psychiatric interventions as well as cultural/social and spiritual re\-enforcement. The agency serves children, youth, adults \& families; it has a rich history of working collaboratively with other agencies to meet the needs of the diverse Chicano/Latino/Indigenous communities, \& other cultural/racial communities in San Francisco.

**JOB/ PROGRAM DESCRIPTION:**

The Chicano/Latino Family Resource system (FRS) is a collaborative project of four community agencies. The project’s purpose is to combine the efforts and staff of the collaborating agencies to develop prevention, early intervention, and intensive case management programs and services which reinforce family preservation with high\-risk families residing in the Mission District and Chicano/Latino families throughout San Francisco.

The Differential Response (DR) program within FRS, works with fifteen partnered community agencies throughout San Francisco and with the Human Services Agency (HSA) to provide services to families referred to CPS and in need of additional support to prevent out of home placement and re\-referrals. This position supervises the Data and Training Specialist, as part of the Differential Response Team. Essential Job Duties are but not limited to the following:

*Program Leadership*

* Coordinate citywide Differential Response (DR) services by serving as the primary point of contact for HSA, FCS, and DEC, uplifting communication and effective service delivery
* Serve as a liaison with HSA and partner agencies by maintaining consistent communication on referrals, service outcomes, and program updates
* Support the ongoing implementation, monitoring, and evaluation of DR program procedures
* Lead implementation of the Family First Prevention Services Act (FFPSA) requirements as they relate to the DR program, ensuring compliance
* Develop and maintain annual schedules for DR\-related meetings, training, and site visits
* Support organizational and programmatic goals by participating in special projects, community events, and other related duties
* Provide leadership to DR Liaisons through consultation, coaching, and technical assistance
* Provide consultation and technical assistance to DR Liaisons and HSA staff citywide, strengthening capacity to respond effectively to family needs.
* Facilitate bi\-monthly DR Liaison meetings to foster collaboration, share resources, and promote alignment across agencies.

*Collaboration, Partnerships \& Communication*

* Lead and facilitate monthly DR Coordination Team meetings, Workgroup meetings, and Case Consultation sessions with CBO partners and HSA staff
* Collaborate with FCS Protective Service Workers, supervisors, and other representatives to determine the best fit for family needs (Red Team Meeting)
* Facilitate bi\-monthly DR Liaison meetings to foster collaboration, share resources, and promote alignment across agencies. (also relevant to capacity building)

*Referral Management \& Service Coordination*

* Triage and assign DR and SafeCare referrals received from HSA to appropriate partner agencies, ensuring timely and equitable service connection for families across the city, ensuring 95% of referrals are responded to within 2 working days

*Quality Assurance, Compliance \& Continuous Quality Improvement (CQI)*

* Conduct quarterly site visits and case chart reviews to ensure compliance with Standards of Quality for Family Strengthening and Support (SQFSS)
* Conduct quarterly quality assurance reviews of partner agencies, assessing compliance, program fidelity, and overall effectiveness of service delivery
* Develop progress reports and include outcomes in quarterly reports, framed in a CQI methodology

*Data Management, Evaluation \& Reporting*

* Prepare and manage Differential Response data collection, entry, and reporting across multiple platforms including FFPSA Master Tracker, CMS Carbon Report, statistical summaries, and quarterly progress reports to meet contractual and collaborative requirements.

**Required Skills:**

* Minimum of three years’ experience providing social services
* Proficient in Microsoft Excel, Access, Word, and Power Point and utilizing email communication ∙ Excellent written and oral skills in English
* Demonstrated ability to manage multiple tasks and organizational skills
* Knowledge and sensitivity to issues of diversity including that of gender, race, language, sexual orientation and socio\-economic status
* Proven ability to communicate effectively under high stress situations; demonstrated diplomacy and sensitivity with clients under stress

**Preferred Skills:**

* Bilingual Spanish/English
* Advanced Excel skills (including Power Query) and familiarity with Microsoft 365 tool
* Knowledge and experience with the San Francisco FRC initiative
* Experience in a non\-profit community agency

**EDUCATION, CERTIFICATIONS AND LICENSES:**

* Must pass and maintain annual Tuberculosis Test
* Must pass Department of Justice Fingerprint screening

jobs.title: Sr. Business Analyst - Value Added Services (VAS) Deal Management
jobs.description:
**About Us**  

Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid.


At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world.


Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you.

**Job Description**


The VAS Deal Management Team partners closely with Sales, Product, Finance, Pricing, Legal, GTM, and Commercial Operations leaders to develop and execute strategic Value\-Added Services (VAS) opportunities across Visa. The team provides commercial deal advisory, financial modeling, pricing strategy, negotiation support, and governance oversight to help structure competitive client solutions while balancing business objectives and profitability. The organization plays a critical role in accelerating deal velocity, improving commercial outcomes, and ensuring alignment with VAS pricing and approval framework

  

* Support VAS sales opportunities across the North America region by providing pricing, financial analysis, and commercial deal support for issuers, acquirers, payment facilitators, merchants, and other partners.
* Partner with Sales and cross\-functional stakeholders, including Finance, Pricing, Product, Marketing, GTM, and Legal, to develop competitive commercial proposals and accelerate deal execution.
* Build financial deal models, pricing analyses, and business cases to support deal structuring, negotiations, and management approvals.
* Coordinate deal reviews and approvals in accordance with VAS governance policies and processes.
* Analyze commercial opportunities and recommend pricing and deal structure options that balance client needs with business objectives.
* Support the preparation of customer\-facing business cases, pricing proposals, and internal approval materials.
* Identify opportunities to improve deal processes, governance, reporting, and seller enablement through increased clarity, automation, and AI\-enabled solutions.
* Develop and maintain deal playbooks, best practices, and knowledge repositories to promote consistency and operational efficiency.
* Collaborate with global and regional Deal Management teams to share insights, support strategic initiatives, and improve commercial outcomes.

  

This role is a Hybrid position to be located in either our Austin, TX or San Francisco, CA office locations. Visa requires at least 3 days in office, expectations of these days will be confirmed by your Hiring Manager.

**Qualifications**

**Basic Qualifications:**

* 5\+ years of relevant work experience with a Bachelor's degree or 4\+ years with an advanced degree (e.g., Master's, MBA, JD, MD), or up to 3 years with a PhD..
* Strong financial modeling, pricing analysis, business case development, and commercial problem\-solving skills.
* Experience partnering with Sales and cross\-functional stakeholders to support complex commercial opportunities and drive business outcomes.
* Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret data, identify trends, and develop actionable recommendations.
* Demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver results in a fast\-paced, matrixed environment.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, CRM platforms (Salesforce or Microsoft Dynamics), and AI\-enabled productivity tools.
* Self\-starter with a continuous improvement mindset, strong attention to detail, and the ability to challenge the status quo while driving execution.
* Strong communication and collaboration skills, with a proven ability to build relationships across functions and geographies.
* Team\-oriented mindset with a focus on accountability, business impact, and shared success.

 **Preferred Qualifications:**

* 6 or more years of work experience with a Bachelor’s Degree or 4 or more years of relevant experience with an Advanced Degree (e.g. Masters, MBA, JD, MD) or up to 3 years of relevant experience with a PhD
* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Finance, Accounting, Business, Economics, or a related field.
* Experience in Deal Management, Commercial Operations, Finance, Pricing, Sales Strategy, or a related business function
* Knowledge of Visa and/or Value\-Added Services (VAS) products is a plus

 **Information for US Applicants**


For roles located in the US, the estimated salary range for this position is $109,800 to $206,700 USD per year, which may include potential sales incentive payments (if applicable). Salary may vary depending on job\-related factors which may include knowledge, skills, experience, and location. In addition, this position may be eligible for bonus and equity.Visa has a comprehensive benefits package for which this position may be eligible that includes Medical, Dental, Vision, 401(k), FSA/HSA, Life Insurance, Paid Time Off, and Wellness Program.**Work Hours**


Varies upon the needs of the department.

**Travel Requirements**


This position requires travel 5\-10% of the time.

**Mental/Physical Requirements**


This position will be performed in an office setting. The position will require the incumbent to sit and stand at a desk, communicate in person and by telephone, frequently operate standard office equipment, such as telephones and computers.

**Visa is an EEO Employer**


Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protect veteran status. Visa will also consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with the EEOC guidelines and applicable local law, including the requirements of Article 49 of the San Francisco Police Code.

jobs.title: Sr. E-commerce Account Manager
jobs.description:
Verenigde Staten
San Francisco
As Sr. E\-commerce Account Manager, you are responsible for the day\-to\-day management and growth of our U.S. E\-commerce business, encompassing Amazon, Walmart, and other retail platforms. You will achieve commercial goals by ensuring content optimization, excellent campaign execution, and sales\-driving activities that are fully aligned with our brand strategy and customer needs. Reporting to the Head of Sales Natural Foods, you are a key member of the U.S. Sales Team, collaborating closely with marketing, category, and global eCommerce colleagues to accelerate our digital growth. Taking full ownership of Paid Search, DSP, Digital Shelf management, pricing, and portal operations, the Account Manager will ensure strategies are tailored to each platform, executed with precision, and aligned with Lotus’s overall business objectives. This role combines strategic and operational responsibilities to optimize the company’s digital presence, enhance brand visibility, and drive revenue growth. You will own platform health, oversee retail media planning, and translate insights into actionable strategies that drive revenue, expand distribution, and increase market share.
  
### **Functiebeschrijving**


Daily Operations \& Platform Management:
* Lead daily e\-commerce operations across Amazon, Walmart, Instacart, Target, Thrive, Safeway, and Kroger platforms.
* Conduct content and PDP audits, and manage Brand Store updates.
* Maintain scorecards, and pacing tools (including MTD pacing, weekly order review, forecast, and finance check\-ins).

Commercial Planning \& Financial Management:
* Collaborate on promotional planning and ensure strong execution
* Support trade spend tracking, true\-ups, and TPM checkbook analysis.
* Own account forecasting and operational troubleshooting in close partnership with the supply chain team

Paid Media \& Advertising:
* Partner with internal teams and external agencies (e.g., Tinuiti, Amazon, Walmart, Instacart, Costco, Target) to plan, launch, and optimize paid search, DSP, and retail media campaigns.
* Manage media planning and strategy (annual/monthly plans, ROAS targets, budget splits, ecommerce scorecard).
* Execute campaign setup and launch across platforms.
* Perform optimization and bid management (keyword targeting, budget reallocation, ACoS goals).
* Leverage Amazon Marketing Cloud for insights and advanced targeting (audience testing).
* Conduct search terms analysis for trends and insights applicable to paid search strategy.
* Review Amazon AMS spend pacing and adjust strategy as needed.
* Perform paid search campaign optimization for Amazon, Walmart, Instacart, Costco, Thrive, and Target.
* Review DSP ads and conduct pulse checks.

Reporting, Insights \& Communication:
* Prepare and deliver weekly, monthly, and global business recaps.
* Provide detailed performance insights, visualizations, and actionable recommendations.
* Conduct competitive benchmarking (SOV, media trends, category performance).
* Communicate campaign impact and partner with internal teams and stakeholders.
* Refresh monthly Amazon Ads and Walmart Ads performance recaps for global connects.

Strategy \& Innovation:
* Pilot new retail media formats and explore beta features.
* Develop audience strategies using 1P/retailer data.
* Support A/B testing (creative tests, placements tests, dayparting).
* Analyze search term reports, category trends, and competitor activity to identify growth opportunities and inform content, pricing, and media strategies.

Cross\-Functional Collaboration \& Relationships:
* Coordinate with brand (global/local), insights, and category teams for media plan alignment.
* Work cross\-functionally with marketing and creative to request content updates for key seasons, new item launches, and ad hoc as needed.
* Build strong relationships with platform partners ensuring deliverables and opportunities are leveraged.
### **Profiel**


* Proven experience (4\-6 years) in e\-commerce account management, with a track record of managing multiple accounts and platforms ideally within CPG
* Expertise in e\-commerce platforms such as Amazon, Walmart, and Costco, with advanced knowledge of Paid Search, DSP, Digital Shelf management, penalties, and pricing.
* Strong analytical skills to assess campaign performance and make data\-driven decisions.
* Demonstrated success in managing cross\-platform advertising budgets and optimizing campaigns for performance.
* Excellent analytical skills with the ability to interpret data and translate insights into actionable strategies.
* Proficiency in Excel or similar tools for reporting and data analysis.
* Proven ability to optimize product listings and manage compliance responsibilities on Amazon.

  
### **Aanbod**


To be determined.

jobs.title: Technical Customer Success Manager
jobs.description:
**About us**
------------


MintMCP helps companies put agents to work safely. We exist to help companies do more of their work with agents, and we build the infrastructure that makes a company's own work runnable by them. Our product gives those agents governed access to company data and tools. That has to start from trust.

  

Before agents can touch Slack, GitHub, Jira, Snowflake, internal databases, or production systems, you need to know what they can reach, what they did, and why they were allowed to do it. Most people carry far more permissions than any single task needs. If an agent uses your token directly, it inherits all of them. MintMCP scopes that access down to exactly what an agent needs to do its job and captures the data flows and audit logs security teams need. From there we are building the rest of the agent stack: connectors, monitoring, sandboxing, long\-running agents, and memory, with the goal of becoming the system a company's work runs on.

  

We work in person in the San Francisco Bay Area. The structure is flat and the market moves fast, so you have a lot of latitude over what you work on and how.

  

We are AI\-native. Everyone uses Claude and Codex every day, and we have more agents than employees. They run in Slack alongside the team and handle sales, marketing, deal ops, and engineering on the same gateway we sell to customers, and we are building an entire company operating system around them.

  

Since launching in February 2026, we have grown to 50\+ paying customers, with strong inbound demand. Customers include Coursera, Arlo, and Braze. We are backed by Cowboy Ventures and Coatue, with angels including Frederic Kerrest (Okta), Michael Grinich (WorkOS), Andrej Karpathy, Jeff Dean, and Scott Belsky. Our founders are machine learning experts from Stanford, Berkeley, and CMU, with applied research at Google Brain and Waymo, and one co\-founded Coursera.

  

**The job**
-----------


You own the customer once the deal is signed, all the way through. On day one that means building the mutual delivery plan with the customer: what success looks like, who does what, and by when. You drive onboarding, get the product live against real use cases, and stay close as usage grows. You are the person the customer trusts to make their rollout work.

  

From there you own the whole arc. You track account health, run the check\-ins and business reviews, catch problems before they become risks, and pull in engineering or the founders when a customer needs more than you can give them alone. You own renewals, and you find and grow expansion, more teams, more agents, more of the company's work running on us. When something is on fire, you are the one who owns getting it resolved.

  

You'll also push in both directions. On the customer side, that means telling them when what they've asked for isn't what they need, and reframing it against what we've seen work elsewhere. Internally, it means advocating for your customers clearly and directly to the founders — while weighing what they want against what the company needs to prioritize. We'd rather you argue with us than quietly agree with a customer.

  

You are our first dedicated post\-sales hire, so you also build the function. You turn what works into a repeatable motion: the delivery plan template, health scoring, the review rhythm, the handoff from sales. As the customer base grows, you help decide who we hire next and grow into leading customer success. The role is in person, with travel to meet customers.

  

**About you**
-------------

* You are exceptional with customers. People trust you quickly, and you keep a rollout on track without being told to. This is the core of the job.
* You have owned customer relationships end to end, in customer success, account management, consulting, or a client\-delivery role.
* You can run a plan and drive it to an outcome across a customer's team, aligning stakeholders, tracking commitments, and keeping momentum.
* You are comfortable in technical conversations without being an engineer. You can hold your own with a technical buyer, explain what the product does and why it matters, and know when to pull in the team for the deep end. You do not write config or debug integrations.
* You have carried retention and expansion, or have the commercial instinct to, and can point to relationships you kept and grew.
* You have built structure where there was none, playbooks, templates, cadences, and you would rather build the motion than inherit one.
* You are calm under pressure and own the outcome when a customer is unhappy.
* You are AI\-native, or will get there fast, and are genuinely curious about AI, agents, and how companies adopt them.
* You move fast without a lot of process, and you want to grow into leading a team.

  

**Bonus**
---------

* AI solutions engineer or forward\-deployed engineer background.
* You've sold to or supported technical and engineering buyers.
* Experience with enterprise rollouts where security review, procurement, and multi\-threading are part of the relationship.
* Comfort representing the company in person: business reviews, dinners, and on\-site meetings with technical and security leaders.

  

**What we offer**
-----------------

* Competitive base, variable, and significant equity.
* Full ownership of your accounts, with room to build the function and grow into leadership.
* Direct access to the CEO, customers, and product decisions.
* Health benefits, on a team that puts family and health first.

 *Prefer to have your agent apply? Point it at* *https://www.mintmcp.com/hiring/mcp*

jobs.title: Patient Care Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Patient Care Coordinator** **Berkeley Hearing Center \- Berkeley, CA** **Full\-time, In\-Person**

**About Berkeley Hearing Center**

Berkeley Hearing Center has been the audiologist\-led home for premium hearing healthcare in the East Bay for more than seven decades. We don't dispense hearing aids. We build long\-term clinical relationships, guided by our Berkeley Hearing Method (Understand, Build, Adapt, Protect), and powered by a team that genuinely believes care should never be compromised.

This is a practice built on depth, not volume. Our patients are educated, discerning, and often navigating one of the more significant health decisions of their lives. They deserve a front\-line experience that honors that.

**The Role**

We are looking for a Patient Care Coordinator to join a well\-staffed, well\-supported front\-office team. This is a full clinical\-support role, not a reception position. You will be the first voice a new patient hears, the last person they interact with after an appointment, and a consistent presence in a care relationship that may span years.

While it may feel like a routine appointment to our schedule, it is a significant moment for the person walking through the door. Your job is to make sure they feel that difference every single time.

**Who You Are**

Experience matters. But character matters more. If your friends and coworkers would describe you like this, we want to meet you:

* Always warm, positive, and genuinely enjoyable to be around
* Friendly and approachable from the very first hello, including over the phone
* Patient, calm, and compassionate, especially with older adults
* A team player who pitches in without being asked and puts the team before ego
* Detailled and acurate: you double\-check your work and rarely make mistakes
* Takes ownership: gives credit, takes initiative and responsibility, and solves problems
* Comfortable multi\-tasking and confident under pressure
* Coachable and open to feedback, always looking to improve
* Reliable and consistent: here, on time, and prepared

That's not just who we're looking for. It's also who you'll be working alongside.

**Core Responsibilities**

* Answer inbound calls and schedule appointments with empathy and clinical awareness, guiding patients through a process that can feel unfamiliar or daunting
* Manage provider schedules to balance new\-patient access with continuity of care for returning patients
* Prepare audiologists for appointments with complete, accurate notes and relevant patient history
* Welcome patients in a way that reflects the quality of care they are about to receive
* Coordinate hearing technology orders, repairs, and manufacturer communications
* Handle patient check\-out, payment collection, and financial policy communication with clarity and confidence

**What We're Looking For**

* Strong interpersonal skills, particularly with older adults and their families
* Detail\-oriented with a genuine understanding of HIPAA and patient confidentiality
* Technologically confident: VoIP phones, online scheduling, digital fax queues, and a willingness to learn new systems
* A clear, confident communicator in writing and in person
* Someone who helps patients understand the value of treatment through honest, educational conversation
* Spanish fluency is a meaningful advantage in our patient community
* Healthcare or audiology front\-office experience is a plus, but we hire for the person first

**What You Get**

* $25\-28/hour base pay
* Health and dental coverage after 60 days
* Team\-based bonus opportunities tied to practice performance
* Profit\-sharing 401(k) after one year
* Real growth potential as the practice expands
* A team that is genuinely glad you're here

**How to Apply**

Send us your resume and a brief note explaining why this role is the right fit for you.

One more thing: this posting contains exactly two spelling errors. Point them out. It tells us something important about how you work.

We look forward to meeting you.

Job Type: Full\-time

Pay: $25\.00 \- $28\.00 per hour

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* Dental insurance
* Health insurance
* Opportunities for advancement
* Paid sick time
* Paid time off
* Profit sharing

Work Location: In person

Hyperfine, Inc. (Nasdaq: HYPR) is the groundbreaking health technology company that has redefined brain imaging with the *Swoop**®*system—the first FDA\-cleared, portable, ultra\-low\-field, magnetic resonance brain imaging system capable of providing imaging at multiple points of care in a healthcare facility. Our mission is to revolutionize patient care globally through transformational, accessible, clinically relevant diagnostic imaging. Learn More


**About The Role**



Job Title**:**Clinical Support Specialist



The Clinical Support Specialist is responsible for all aspects of the initial training and support for the customer team, including physicians, nurses, radiographers, MRI Technologists, and other relevant personnel in the use of Hyperfine's Swoop Portable MRI System. This role will assist in optimizing customer experience by acting as a true consultant with regards to integrating the Swoop System within a customer's workflow and procedures. The person in this role will partner effectively to relay customer feedback to internal Hyperfine teams and will function as the clinical specialist during the product sales cycle in close collaboration with the Sales, Marketing, Clinical Science, and R\&D groups. They will also support clinical adoption, utilization, customer engagement, and related account activities for our customers.


**RESPONSIBILITIES:**


* Train hospital staff on the safe and effective use and operation of Hyperfine products within the clinical areas including amending workflow and optimize product value and utilization
* Provide customized training and support for new operators of the Swoop System and maintain strategic relationships and support post\-installation
* Develop and maintain relationships in accounts with key personnel within the hospital and consult on best practices and use cases
* Provide R\&D with clinical input and feedback for new projects
* Support the sales team by identifying customer needs and relaying potential opportunities within the existing installed base
* Support new product evaluation and clinical studies
* Support the centers in optimizing their standard procedures and workflows
* Support adoption and utilization activities and escalate retention or expansion opportunities
* Collaborate with the sales team by providing technical support in various sales cycles to win new business, including accompanying site visits as needed for demonstrations
* Work with the sales team to support Swoop utilization activities
* Support assigned opportunities to enhance client relationships and increase adoption within a facility or network.
* Partner with internal stakeholders (ex. sales, product, marketing, clinical sciences, clinical applications) to share feedback, identify trends, and make introductions that result in increased value for the customer and Hyperfine
* Identify potential attrition risks and product gaps and escalate them with recommended follow\-up actions.
* Work closely with teammates and/or RN counterparts to provide customer success to install base customers and future potential customers
* Represent Hyperfine and demonstrate products at trade shows and society meetings
* Support MRI peer champion and Key Opinion Leader (KOL) development activities.
* MRI safety and screening knowledge and analyzing contraindications regarding portable low field vs. high field MR
* MRI sequence and protocol understanding workflow optimization
* Support scanner software and firmware upgrades for customers
* Perform scanner implementations at customer sites
* Perform virtual and on site training of scanners to customers
* Participate in image review with customer physicians and Hyperfine medical officers
* Backup / support for image demonstrations
* Case review with healthcare staff
* Trade show image support and case reviews


**KNOWLEDGE AND SKILL:**


* In\-depth knowledge reading of the critical care setting to make consultative clinical recommendations to optimize procedures
* Experience working with a variety of stakeholders including physicians, business administration, clinical, etc.
* Ability to build effective relationships with customer stakeholders and support adoption of clinical workflows
* Strong problem solver with sound judgment
* Hands on, strong team player, and fully accountable for delivering agreed\-upon tactical performance metrics
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills
* Highly organized and able to multitask
* Articulate, analytical, technically savvy, and professional
* Strong computer skills
* Self\-driven and self sufficient
* Positive attitude and team player\-oriented individual
* Excellent time management, including managing daily schedule, travel plans, and expenses


**EDUCATION/EXPERIENCE REQUIRED:**


* Associate's degree in Radiology Sciences or related field
* Registered Technologist with the ARRT (American Registry of Radiologic Technologists) and current credentialing in MR (Magnetic Resonance) or equivalent
* 3\+ years' experience in clinical MR imaging or similar experience such as 3\+ years X\-ray \+ 2 years in MRI in a hospital setting
* 2\+ years' experience operating in clinical applications or clinical training experience


**PHYSICAL DEMANDS:**


* Reside in assigned territory and ability to work from home\-based office
* Able to travel up to 75% of the time within and outside of territory, including occasional weekend travel
* Ability to work long hours and execute under pressure with short turnaround times
* Live near a major airport

jobs.title: Lead Care Manager
jobs.description:
ABOUT US
Homebridge serves a high risk, high needs, complex\-diagnosed population with a combination of domestic, personal, and paramedical homecare functions funded through IHSS. Our work allows an often\-underserved population to live safely in their community. Homebridge offers a dynamic, fast\-paced work environment with 350\+ unionized field workers and 90\+ internal office staff.  

POSITION SUMMARY
The Lead Care Manager oversees the delivery of Enhanced Care Management services for Medi‑Cal members with complex medical, behavioral, and social needs. This role provides clinical oversight, supports care managers, ensures fidelity to CalAIM ECM requirements, and maintains high‑quality, person‑centered care coordination across medical, behavioral health, community, and social service systems.  

ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS* Conduct comprehensive assessments of clients' health, social, and environmental needs to develop personalized care plans.
* Support clients in engaging in the Enhanced Care Management seven core services, including outreach and engagement, comprehensive assessment/care management planning, enhanced care coordination, health promotion, comprehensive transitional care, individual and family supports, and referrals to community/social supports.
* Coordinate with healthcare providers, social services, and other community resources to ensure clients receive holistic and continuous care.
* Regularly monitor clients' progress, adjusting care plans as necessary, and conduct follow\-up visits or calls to ensure they are adhering to their care plans.
* Advocate on behalf of clients to secure necessary services and support, ensuring their needs and preferences are met.
* Maintain accurate and timely documentation of client interactions, care plans, and progress reports, ensuring compliance with organizational and regulatory standards.
* Educate clients and their families about their health conditions, treatment options, and available resources to empower them to make informed decisions.
* Work collaboratively with multidisciplinary teams to ensure integrated and coordinated care, participating in case conferences and team meetings as needed.
  

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, AND ABILITIES* Ability to understand and use computer applications, including spreadsheets and electronic health records; including internet access and email.
* Ability to understand the needs of clients from different cultures and socioeconomic backgrounds.
* Awareness of community resources and services.
* Effective organizational and time management skills.
* Ability to solve problems and be proactive.
* Ability to communicate effectively and professionally with coworkers, clients and members of the community.
* Ability to travel within the service area.
  

EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE* Two (2\) years of experience in Mental Health or community services; or Bachelor's degree in Social Services or related field.
* Experience working in case or care management, preferably with a background in healthcare or social services.
  

WORK ENVIRONMENT
This position will have in the field and office work environments which includes frequent travel \- must be able to travel on foot or via public transportation to all parts of San Francisco County for performance of job duties. May occasionally be exposed to outside weather conditions while traveling to clients. Some exposure to physical risk. Exposure to client apartments, rooms, homes and other venues so that services can be provided, client homes may have pets/pet dander and/or cigarette smoke. May include contact with clients with mental health and/or personal hygiene issues.  

PHYSICAL DEMANDS
The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individual with disabilities to perform the essential functions. While performing the duties of the job, the employee is regularly required to talk or hear. The employee is frequently required to sit for extended periods of time at a desk or computer workstation. The employee is frequently required to stand, walk, sit, use hands to finger, handle, or feel, reach with hands and arms. The employee is occasionally required to climb or balance and stoop, kneel, or crouch. The employee may occasionally lift and/or move up to 15 pounds. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, color vision, and ability to adjust focus. *Homebridge Is an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran or disability status.*

jobs.description:
**ASE MANAGER II**

**Location: Coronado Hotel**

**Hourly Wage: $30\.44 Status: Non\-exempt, Hourly**

**Benefited After 1 month intro period**

 **Community Forward SF** is a collection of vital programs that ensures our neighbors experiencing homelessness have effective services designed for their unique needs. Whether one needs housing, medical shelter, a safe place to become sober, or calm in the face of domestic violence \- we care for those most vulnerable in our community.

  

We are not just one program. We are a network of programs designed to work together to meet every stage of need. We focus on the hardest to reach, most vulnerable people: Women \& Trans Women, Medical Crisis, Substance Use Disorder, and Older Adults. Our programs meet the needs of people, rather than demanding that people meet the needs of our programs.

 **JOB SUMMARY:**


Community Forward SF is hiring a Case Manager for our permanent supportive housing site, The Coronado. Case Managers assist our tenants with all needs relating to keeping housing, provide services to support client mental and physical health as well as personal safety, and assist in navigating a complex system by providing information, education, and referral services.

  

The Coronado is an SRO specializing in housing those with trauma. Residents staying at the Coronado are given intensive support services including assessment, mental health support, crisis intervention, substance use disorder referrals, conflict resolution, mediation, benefits counseling, advocacy, employment services, and in home support services via outside providers, such as medical counseling and access to food pantry programs.

 **ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS:**

* Establish and maintain a caseload of clients, provide services including, but not limited to, individual counseling, crisis intervention, assessment, case management, substance abuse support, advocacy and facilitation of a minimum of 2 weekly support groups.
* Develop treatment plans with timelines for individual goals and objectives.
* Meet with clients on a weekly basis to ensure successful engagement with and completion of treatment plan
* Ensure access to resources that help stabilize clients’ income through benefits advocacy, housing, medical status, and other needs, including social service systems and other agencies.
* Conduct outreach to encourage program usage and make referrals to Community Forward SF Mental Health Outpatient Program or other appropriate programs based on client need
* Maintain client charts and associated documentation in a timely manner by successfully and effectively utilizing City electronic health record systems that may include Avatar, ONE Clarity, ARIES as well as successful use of G\-Suites applications.
* Submit client progress notes and updates to clinical supervisor on a weekly basis
* Meet with clinical supervisor on a weekly basis and present client cases during monthly Group Supervision meetings
* Assist clients in attending appointments with outside service providers.
* Coordinate care with client service providers to ensure quality service and continuity of care
* Assist clients in developing external support systems.
* Assist with medication monitoring.
* Adhere to established policies and procedures.
* Ensure that clients are treated with dignity and respect, and that their physical needs are adequately met while residing at the facility.
* Support our mission to promote stabilization, hope, and healing for adults experiencing homelessness in San Francisco.
* Mandatory training and meeting attendance.
* Other duties as assigned.

 **BACKGROUND \& EXPERIENCE**:

* Bachelor’s (B.A.) degree or equivalent in education and work experience.
* Previous case management experience and/or training.
* Comfort with technology including basic knowledge of Microsoft Office Suite, Google Suite, and city housing databases and electronic health record systems, including but not limited to Avatar, ONE Clarity System, ARIES Database.
* Possess ability to write clear and clinically\-relevant client progress notes, treatment plans, assessments, and associated clinical reports.
* Possesses basic knowledge of DSM\-V diagnoses and classifications.
* Possess basic knowledge of clinical orientations, modalities and interventions.
* Possess effective communication skills and the ability to work both independently and cooperatively.
* Ability to de\-escalate conflict
* Knowledge of homelessness, healthcare, substance abuse, HIV, harm reduction, co\-occurring disorders, dementia/cognitive impairment, cultural diversity issues and relevant resources.
* Able to work effectively with diverse individuals who self\-identify by cultural, language, neighborhood, sexual identity, gender and other definitions.
* Ability to write and speak English effectively.
* CPR and first aid certification required within 90 days of hire.
* 5150 Trained \& Certified within the first year of hire or promotion.

 **PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:**

* Bicultural, bilingual Spanish speaking.
* Knowledge of San Francisco community resources, including the ONE coordinated entry system.
* Experience working with at\-risk client populations.
* Potential to work/be on\-call on evenings and/or weekends.

### **Role Summary**


Are you an organized, compassionate, and detail\-oriented professional who excels at providing seamless administrative support in a vibrant care environment? We are seeking an energetic **Center Coordinator – Adult Day Program** to support operational excellence and foster a warm, inclusive community for older adults.


In this dynamic, key support role, you will work under the supervision of the Adult Day Program Manager to ensure smooth daily center operations, including activity logistics, caregiver scheduling, transportation routing, and electronic recordkeeping. You will serve as an essential ambassador for our patients and community members, championing a welcoming, empowering environment with a strong commitment to serving diverse populations, including LGBTQ seniors. If you thrive in an engaging, fast\-paced setting and love helping others, we encourage you to apply!

### **Duties \& Responsibilities**

#### **Operations \& Care Coordination**

* **Center Administration:** Provide broad administrative and operational support across daily program activities, meal services, personal care scheduling, intake needs, and patient/staff safety protocols.
* **Caregiver Team Support:** Collaborate with program management to assist in overseeing the caregiver team, including coordinate scheduling and daily workflow support.
* **Transportation \& Scheduling:** Coordinate transportation logistics and routing to ensure patients arrive safely and on time for program activities.
* **Documentation \& Data Entry:** Maintain accurate electronic records, complete required Electronic Health Record (EHR) data entry, and generate operational reports as requested.
* **Inclusive Environment:** Champion an inclusive, welcoming culture for all patients and community members, demonstrating sensitivity to diversity and intersectionality within the community.
* **Cross\-Functional Partnering:** Work collaboratively with management and center staff to enhance program quality, operational efficiency, and overall team success.
* **Frontline Engagement:** Serve as a warm, professional point of contact for patients, families, and visiting partners, assisting with basic translation or interpretation as needed if bilingual.
* **Compliance \& Safety:** Maintain a clean, orderly workspace and comply with all administrative, safety, background clearance, and health screening protocols (including TB testing).
* Other duties as assigned.

### **Required Qualifications**

#### **Education \& Certifications**

* **Education:** High School Diploma or GED equivalent.
* **Age Requirement:** Must be at least 18 years of age.
* **Certifications:** Active CPR and First Aid Certifications (required upon hire).
* **Clearances:** Ability to clear a standard background check and obtain required medical clearances (including health screening and TB test).

#### **Experience \& Technical Skills**

* **Administrative Background:** Minimum of one (1\) year of administrative, coordinator, or office support experience.
* **Computer Proficiency:** Skilled in Microsoft Office Suite, electronic scheduling systems, EHR platforms, and standard office technology.
* **Communication Skills:** Excellent verbal and written communication skills with a warm, professional, and patient\-centered demeanor.
* **Adaptability \& Organization:** Highly organized with exceptional multi\-tasking skills, able to prioritize effectively in a busy environment with frequent interruptions.

### **Desired Qualifications**

* **Community Specialty:** 2 to 4 years of experience working in healthcare, adult day care, or senior care settings, with a preferred focus or demonstrated interest in serving LGBTQ seniors.
* **Bilingual Ability:** Fluency in a second language is a strong plus (capable of providing basic translation for patients and staff).

### **Location and Work Type**

* **Work Type:** Full\-Time Position (Contract).
* **Work Setting:** On\-Site Ambulatory/Day Center Environment.
* **Schedule:** Full\-time (Monday– Friday \- shift schedule).

**I strive to reply within 48 hours. Looking forward to connecting with you soon. Thank you!**

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, Data & Onboarding
jobs.description:
**About Us**
------------


Founded in 2021, Axion is at the forefront of transforming product quality and customer satisfaction in manufacturing. Our cutting\-edge AI\-powered platform empowers manufacturers to swiftly identify, thoroughly investigate, and effectively resolve quality issues while simultaneously elevating customer experiences and outcomes.


As trailblazers in end\-to\-end quality intelligence, we're setting new industry standards. Our innovative approach enables industrial, aerospace, consumer, and medtech manufacturers to harness the power of quality and post\-market data, driving down costs and boosting business performance.


Our vision extends beyond mere problem\-solving; we're committed to reshaping the future of manufacturing. By seamlessly integrating advanced AI technology with deep industry expertise, Axion is paving the way for smarter, safer, and more efficient production processes across diverse sectors.


Backed by leading investors, including Bessemer Venture Partners, Amplo, Boeing, and RTX Ventures, Axion is poised to lead the quality revolution in manufacturing.

**About the Role**
------------------


We're looking for a Senior Product Manager to own the data foundation and onboarding experience of the Axion platform: how a customer's raw quality data becomes a workspace engineers trust, from data handoff to their first actionable issues to investigate and resolve.


Product quality problems affect safety, cost, and the people who use what manufacturers build. The data behind those issues arrives messy, inconsistent, and full of domain language. How well we turn it into something quality engineers can trust sets how fast customers launch, how much effort it takes us, and how good Axion's AI and agents are after launch. Your first priority is making onboarding fast and repeatable while keeping the data and AI output trustworthy. You'll set the product direction for how Axion understands customer data.


This is a senior individual contributor role working closely with Engineering, Design, Solutions, and Operations. You'll thrive here if you like getting into real customer data, working side by side with engineers, and building AI products people have to trust.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* Own the path from data handoff to a usable workspace: data setup, transformations, mappings, readiness, and a customer's first useful issues.
* Collaborate with customers, engineering, and operations to define the vision, strategy, and roadmap for our data products, aligning these with company goals and user needs.
* Turn manual setup work into repeatable product capability, so each new customer takes less time and internal effort to bring on.
* Decide how customer data is structured, linked, classified, and turned into issues, and how that evolves as the product and our AI change.
* Capture what Axion needs to know about a customer's products, components, and failure modes during onboarding, and use it to improve classification, seed the customer's knowledge hub, and give AI agents better context.
* Learn from every onboarding alongside Solutions, Operations, and customers, and feed what you learn back into the product.

**Requirements**
----------------

* 5\+ years of product management in B2B software, including a product built around messy customer data or AI output customers need to trust.
* Hands\-on data fluency: demonstrated experience owning data schemas, taxonomies, data ingestion pipelines, or similar data\-product surfaces
* Experience measuring AI output quality: you've defined what "correct" looks like, used labeled examples, and shown whether a change made results better.
* A track record of turning implementation, onboarding, or operations work into repeatable product, with internal teams as your first users.
* Customer and operator judgment: you can work directly with a customer and the team doing the setup, run a focused pilot, and decide how to improve the product experience from the results.
* Experience at a venture\-backed startup.

**Nice to Have**
----------------

* Experience in manufacturing, quality, warranty, field service, or another complex operational domain.
* Background in data preparation, data quality, data labeling, or evaluation products.
* Experience with taxonomies, classification systems, knowledge capture, or designing context for AI agents.
* A past life in implementation, solutions, or customer onboarding before moving into product.

**Who You Are**
---------------


You’re a builder and operator who thrives in fast\-moving, high\-accountability environments. You take pride in getting things done — thoughtfully, efficiently, and without drama. You’re energized by ambiguity, skilled at bringing clarity, and comfortable flexing between strategy and execution.


You value feedback — giving it, receiving it, and acting on it — and you see collaboration as a competitive advantage, not a burden. You’re low\-ego but high\-agency: you care about winning as a team more than being right individually. You move quickly, communicate directly, and make decisions grounded in impact and data.


You don’t need constant direction — you create momentum. You take ownership for outcomes, and you expect the same from those around you.

**How We Operate**
------------------


We move fast, work smart, and hold ourselves to a high bar. Axion is a place for people who take pride in their craft and are motivated by meaningful work. We respect time off and boundaries, but we’re also realistic: hard problems sometimes require weekend pushes or late\-night thinking sessions. We support that balance — intensity with respect for recharge.

jobs.title: Palliative Care Social Work Case Manager

**Job Description**

***A bit about this role***


This specific role provides Social Work support to our Palliative Care Program.


Devoted’s virtual Palliative Care program serves members with complex needs and life\-limiting illness who otherwise would not have access to specialized palliative care. We pride ourselves on providing highly compassionate, patient\-centered goals of care counseling and symptom management for members projected to be in the final year of life. We meet patients where they are and support them in defining quality of life, achieving meaningful goals, and transitioning to hospice care.


As a Palliative Care Social Work Case Manager, you will serve our patients as an advocate, coach, and connector \- working closely with patients, caregivers and other members of the team to identify and eliminate socioeconomic and psychosocial barriers and provide supportive counseling. This role will require you to develop individualized care plans that align community, clinical, and patients’ personal resources.You will provide coaching on improving coping skills, self\-management, and caregiver assistance, re\-enforce disease\-specific education and facilitate goals of care and advanced care planning discussions, including hospice care transitions when appropriate.


Responsibilities will include:

* Telephonic and video visits with patients and caregivers
* Establish trust and build strong relationships with our patients
* Interdisciplinary collaboration with teammates (including clinicians, nurses, and care coordinators) to ensure cohesive, patient\-centered care for high\-needs patients
* Conduct Social Work interventions to maximize the effectiveness of the program


	+ Conduct psychosocial assessments and create personalized care plans tailored to members’ needs
	+ Provide emotional and caregiver support
	+ Assist in navigating complex family/support issues
	+ Complete goals of care conversations and advanced care planning
	+ Conduct long term care planning and placements
	+ Place/follow through on behavioral health referrals
	+ Investigate concerns for patient abuse or neglect
* Know how to balance multiple competing priorities from complex patients
* Work with family members/caregivers to help them in understanding the member’s needs and how they can be supportive
* Manage or lead conversations with patients, caregivers, and family regarding goals of care, and social drivers of advanced care planning
* Facilitate and participate in family meetings and joint visits
* Participate in team huddles, panel reviews, interdisciplinary team rounds, and program/role growth and development
* Build relationships and coordinate with key local market and internal stakeholders
* Document all clinical interactions in the electronic health record

***Attributes to success***

* Ability to walk alongside those with terminal illness and to gentle the sacred transition from life to death
* You meet patients and families where they are, hold them with compassion, and are able to release yourself from the outcome
* You love helping others improve their health and navigate a complex healthcare system with compassion, empathy, and warmth
* You’re a caring problem solver who can break down barriers

* Extrapolate health intelligence data to create wellbeing programs that drive sustainable change, influence individual behavior that support business results for a variety of clients.
* Support internal training
* Integrates with firm’s wellness resources
* Participates in prospective client presentations

* Drives sustainable engagement and individual behaviors that support business results for a variety of clients
Offer appropriate well\-being solutions based on cultural assessment and clinical data. Challenges support adult learning and sustainable change.

jobs.description:
**About Net at Work**

  

Founded in 1996, Net at Work is one of North America’s largest technology advisors and solution providers for small and mid\-size businesses. Our award\-winning consultancy offers a rich portfolio of next\-generation technology, industry expertise, implementation and managed services to help organizations derive value from the transformative benefits of technology.  

  

Through the integration of ERP, HCM and/or CRM solutions, Net at Work offers unique, industry\-specific solutions and operation platforms that enable companies to compete more effectively in today’s digital economy. For more information, visit www.netatwork.com.

 **About this Position**


As Net at Work continues to evolve its internal systems, processes, and technology platforms, we are seeking a Systems Learning Specialist to support employee readiness, technology adoption, and learning enablement across the organization.

  

The Systems Learning Specialist plays a key role in helping employees successfully adopt and utilize business systems, tools, and processes. This role partners closely with Learning \& Development, Systems Operations, and business stakeholders to transform system requirements, workflows, and process updates into engaging and effective learning experiences.

  

This position is focused on the execution of training initiatives, including content development, facilitation, documentation, and user adoption support across multiple technology platforms.

 **Job Responsibilities**

* Develop and deliver instructor\-led, virtual, and self\-paced training programs for employees.
* Create engaging learning materials including presentations, job aids, quick reference guides, videos, process documentation, and knowledge articles.
* Support employee adoption of business systems including ticketing platforms, HR systems, collaboration tools, and operational applications.
* Translate system updates, process changes, and business requirements into clear learning content.
* Conduct platform walkthroughs, testing, and hands\-on exploration to understand workflows and user experiences before developing training materials.
* Facilitate new system launches, enhancements, and adoption initiatives.
* Assist with AI enablement efforts by developing and delivering foundational AI learning content and best practices.
* Maintain and update training materials to ensure content remains accurate and current.
* Partner with subject matter experts to gather information and validate training effectiveness.
* Support employee onboarding and ongoing learning initiatives related to business systems and technology tools.
* Track participation, feedback, and adoption metrics to continuously improve learning programs.

 **Job Requirements**

* 2\-5 years of experience in corporate training, learning and development, employee enablement, instructional design, or systems training.
* Experience creating training content and learning materials.
* Strong presentation and facilitation skills.
* Ability to quickly learn new software platforms and business processes.
* Excellent written communication and documentation skills.
* Strong organizational and project coordination abilities.
* Proficiency with Microsoft 365 applications including PowerPoint, Teams, Excel, Word, and SharePoint.
* Experience supporting software implementations or system rollouts.
* Experience with ticketing systems, CRM platforms, HRIS platforms, or workflow applications.
* Familiarity with learning management systems and digital learning tools.
* Experience creating video\-based learning content or microlearning assets.
* Exposure to AI tools and AI\-assisted content development.

 **Customer Requirements**


This job may require access to customer information, systems, and/or premises. As a result, this job may require customer approval for such access as an essential job function.

 **Core Competencies**

* **Client Champion** – Relentlessly exceed client expectations. Consistently anticipate needs to deliver valuable solutions and extraordinary outcomes.
* **Problem Solver** – Smart, analytical, inquisitive, knowledge\-seeker that thrives on a challenge.
* **Promise Keeper** – Place high value on keeping our word and doing the right thing. Demonstrate honesty, integrity, and commitment.
* **Collaborative Integrator** –Team player, unifier, relationship\-oriented, win\-win seeker, exemplify the concept of relationships through trust and unity.
* **Driven Intrapreneur** – Exceed goals using independent creative thinking, optimism, self\-confidence, and a can\-do attitude.
* **Inspiring Coach** – Help employees, clients and partners using knowledge, expertise, experience, and situational fluency.

 **Compensation and Benefits**


Base salary range: $85,000 to $95,000\.


This position is also eligible for a bonus in accordance with the terms of the Company's plan.

Additional factors considered in extending an offer include (but are not limited to) experience, including industry or product\-specific experience, education, knowledge, skills, and abilities, as well as internal equity, alignment with market data, and/or other applicable laws.

jobs.title: Territory Account Manager- Services California
jobs.description:
**Why** **You’ll** **Love Working Here**



At SimuTech Group, we are driving innovation and changing the world through the power of engineering simulation. Our growing team of energetic, tech\-savvy professionals works hard every day to inspire our clients to push the boundaries of innovation and deliver transformational products. If you are motivated and driven by a culture where top\-notch work ethic and passion are rewarded, then a career with SimuTech Group may be for you!



**The Benefits of Being Part of Our Team**



* Unmatched Health Coverage: Zero\-cost in\-network medical care with no premiums, deductibles, or copays for you and your family.


* Complete Dental \& Vision Benefits: 100% premium coverage for dental and vision insurance.


* Wellness Programs Tailored to You: Access free workouts, personalized training sessions, nutritional counseling, mindfulness programs, stress management, and more with our corporate wellness coach.
  


**What Makes This Role Great?**



* You’ll thrive in a competitive and results\-driven environment where your leadership, sales expertise, and ability to build relationships are celebrated.


* You’ll have the opportunity to drive revenue growth by connecting with decision\-makers and delivering impactful solutions to meet client needs.


* You’ll join a dynamic sales team that values ambition, creativity, and a passion for achieving goals.
  


**What** **You’ll** **Do**



As a Services Territory Account Manager, you will sell SimuTech consulting services directly to end users via phone, virtual, and face\-to\-face contact. You’ll manage both transactional and complex sales while collaborating closely with a dynamic team of highly skilled engineers who provide technical expertise throughout the sales cycle.



Lead Business Development



* Identify and connect with potential clients, leveraging persuasive communication skills to introduce SimuTech’s consulting solutions.


* Challenge clients by proposing innovative tools and engineering processes, establishing yourself as a trusted advisor.


* Collaborate with inside sales, marketing, and engineering teams to develop customized solutions for client challenges.


Drive Sales Growth

Execute structured, milestone\-driven sales strategies to meet or exceed ambitious revenue goals.



* Manage consultative sales processes, engaging with decision\-makers at all levels to uncover needs and deliver tailored solutions.


* Negotiate and structure consulting deals to drive Ansys software sales and deliver measurable client value.


Build Strong Relationships



* Develop and nurture long\-term partnerships with clients, ensuring ongoing satisfaction and success.


* Organize and lead impactful customer\-facing events, such as workshops, user groups, and industry seminars.


* Represent SimuTech Group at industry events, positioning yourself as an industry expert and thought leader.
  


**What** **You’ll** **Bring**



Education \& Experience



* Bachelor’s degree or a minimum of 5 years of industry experience.


* Previous technical sales or engineering experience.


**Skills**



* Confidence and Independence: You’re a self\-starter who takes initiative and thrives in situations where you can think on your feet.


* Persuasive Communication: You excel at delivering compelling messages and can adapt your style to different audiences.


* Analytical Thinking: You dig deeper to uncover customer needs, crafting solutions that resonate with their challenges.


* Resilience: You handle rejection effectively, maintaining a positive outlook and determination to succeed.


* Technical Expertise: A solid understanding of engineering processes and related technologies (CAD, 3D printing, HPC).


* Time Management: You prioritize effectively and stay organized, even in a fast\-paced, high\-pressure environment.
  


**Additional Benefits**



* Short Term Disability


* Long Term Disability


* 401k Plan with employer match


* Limited Flexible Spending Account


* Life Insurance


* Paid time off


* Professional development assistance


* Referral program


* Tuition reimbursement


* Bonus plan


**Pay range:** Base \- $85,000 \- $100,000 OTE $170,000 \- $200,000 USD  

*(Compensation may vary outside of this range depending on* *a number of* *factors, including a candidate's qualifications, skills, competencies, experience, and location.)*



Location: Remote\-based in California

  


**Take the Next Step**



This is your opportunity to join a forward\-thinking team where your skills, creativity, and ambition will be celebrated. Apply today to become a key player in SimuTech Group’s mission to revolutionize the engineering industry.



SimuTech Group is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer.
