jobs.title: Immigration Case Manager — AI Operations (Mandarin, Fully Remote)
jobs.description:
We are hiring a **Mandarin\-speaking Immigration Case Manager — AI Operations** who combines strong U.S. immigration case\-management experience with advanced AI and legal\-technology skills.

This is not a traditional paralegal position.

We are building an AI\-native immigration practice where highly capable case managers use AI and modern case\-management technology to independently manage substantially more of the case lifecycle—from intake and evidence collection through drafting, quality control, and attorney\-ready review.

You do **not** need to be an AI engineer or programmer.

You **do need to be highly fluent with AI and modern business software and already know how to use Claude effectively for sophisticated immigration work.**

We are specifically looking for someone who understands how to use Claude beyond basic prompting—for example, working with large case files and long\-context documents, structuring complex immigration analysis, extracting and organizing evidence, identifying inconsistencies and missing information, developing evidence matrices, preparing and improving drafts, analyzing RFEs, performing quality control, and building repeatable AI\-assisted workflows.

You should know how to give AI the right context and instructions, evaluate its output critically, verify it against source documents, identify hallucinations or unsupported conclusions, and iterate until the work product meets a professional standard.

**AI proficiency is a core qualification for this position, not something we expect to teach from the beginning.**

**What You’ll Do**

You will take ownership of immigration cases from assignment through attorney review, including:

* Communicating directly with clients in Mandarin and English
* Reviewing intake information, CVs, immigration records, and supporting documents
* Identifying missing information and proactively following up
* Managing case progress, deadlines, and outstanding items
* Preparing immigration forms and supporting documentation
* Organizing evidence and exhibits
* Assisting with petitions, recommendation letters, RFEs, and other case materials
* Using Claude extensively for document analysis, evidence analysis, drafting, case organization, and quality control
* Using modern case\-management and business software efficiently
* Checking AI\-generated work against the underlying record
* Identifying factual inconsistencies and potential issues
* Escalating matters requiring attorney judgment
* Developing better prompts, templates, checklists, and repeatable workflows
* Delivering organized, substantially complete cases for attorney review

The objective is straightforward:

**Once a case is assigned to you, you should be capable of moving it from intake to attorney\-ready review with minimal attorney intervention.**

**Who We’re Looking For**

You may be a strong fit if you have:

* Professional fluency in **Mandarin Chinese and English**
* Meaningful U.S. immigration case\-management or paralegal experience
* **Advanced proficiency using Claude for professional immigration work**
* Strong general AI literacy and the ability to work effectively with large amounts of information
* High proficiency with modern corporate software, document\-management systems, cloud collaboration tools, and case\-management platforms
* Experience independently managing immigration cases
* Excellent organization and attention to factual detail
* Strong written communication skills
* The ability to manage multiple matters without constant attorney supervision
* The judgment to distinguish routine production issues from matters requiring attorney attention

Experience with employment\-based immigration—including **EB\-1A, EB\-2 NIW, O\-1, H\-1B, L\-1, PERM, I\-140, and I\-485**—is highly valued.

Experience at a sophisticated business immigration practice is a plus, but not required.

**What “AI Proficiency” Means to Us**

We are **not** looking for someone whose AI experience consists primarily of asking ChatGPT or Claude to rewrite emails.

A strong candidate should be comfortable demonstrating how they use Claude to work through an actual immigration matter.

For example, you should be able to take a substantial client file and use AI intelligently to:

* understand and structure the case;
* extract relevant facts from multiple documents;
* identify missing or contradictory information;
* create timelines;
* analyze and categorize evidence;
* build evidence matrices;
* analyze publications and citation records;
* organize EB\-1A/O\-1 evidence by criterion;
* organize NIW evidence around the proposed endeavor;
* analyze an RFE against the existing record;
* prepare customized evidence requests;
* produce first drafts from verified source materials;
* compare drafts against underlying evidence;
* perform consistency and quality\-control reviews;
* and turn successful approaches into reusable workflows.

You should also understand AI’s limitations.

**Fast AI\-generated work that contains unsupported facts, missed evidence, or hallucinations is not good work.**

The person we want knows how to make AI powerful **and** reliable.

**Why This Role Is Different**

Most immigration case\-management positions are still structured around traditional production methods.

This one is not.

We want to see what happens when an experienced immigration professional becomes exceptionally effective at combining:

**Immigration knowledge \+ case ownership \+ Claude \+ modern software \+ operational judgment.**

The objective is not simply to draft faster. It is to enable one excellent case manager to perform work that traditionally required substantially more administrative and junior\-production support.

**Career Growth**

This position has a significant growth path for someone who performs exceptionally well:

**Immigration Case Manager — AI Operations**  
→ **Senior Immigration Case Manager — AI Operations**  
→ **AI Operations / Case Management Lead**  
→ **Manager o

**Accounting Operations Manager — QuickBooks Online**

Sunistics Group \| Fully remote, U.S.\-based \| $32–$40 per hour

Flexible weekday scheduling, with availability beginning no later than 7 a.m. Pacific / 10 a.m. Eastern. Weekly hours and working schedule will be agreed before hiring.

**Own the accounting operation**

Sunistics Group delivers commercial solar projects. We need a hands\-on Accounting Operations Manager who takes responsibility for accurate books, reliable payment processing and consistent follow\-through. You will organise the work, resolve issues and keep management informed without needing reminders.

You will work with our existing accounting team and external accountant. This role combines ownership of the accounting workflow with doing the work in QuickBooks Online: reconciling accounts, reviewing records, coordinating approvals and processing payments.

**What you will own**

* Keep QuickBooks Online current each week. Review bank and credit\-card activity, match transactions correctly, maintain project classifications and resolve missing or duplicate entries.
* Own the month\-end checklist and agreed close deadlines. Reconcile bank and credit\-card accounts, investigate differences and provide complete supporting records to our accountant.
* Organise vendor invoices, statements and payment requests. Confirm documentation and approval, schedule and process authorised payments, and follow through on discrepancies.
* Manage crew reimbursement requests from receipt through approval and payment. Check receipts, amounts and project details, resolve missing information and ensure each payment is recorded once.
* Manage shared accounting inboxes and scanned incoming mail. Route requests, assign follow\-up and track deadlines so important items do not get lost.
* Coordinate priorities and review work across the accounting workflow. Maintain clear procedures, identify bottlenecks and escalate issues with a concise explanation and recommended next step.
* Keep cash\-planning inputs reliable, including expected payment dates and unresolved items, while reducing duplicate entry between QuickBooks and company spreadsheets.

**AI proficiency is required**

Using artificial intelligence to improve efficiency is an expectation of this role. You must already be comfortable using tools such as ChatGPT, Microsoft Copilot, Gemini or comparable tools for practical work—not simply interested in learning them later.

* Use company\-approved AI tools to simplify document handling, organise information, analyse spreadsheets, draft communications and document repeatable processes.
* Propose and implement useful improvements, checking whether they save time and improve accuracy.
* Verify AI output against original documents and accounting records. Protect confidential information and follow company rules for approved tools and data use. You remain responsible for accuracy; AI does not replace payment authorisation or accounting judgment.

We will ask for a brief example of an AI\-assisted workflow you have used and how you checked its results. Coding or building AI software is not required.

**What you bring**

* At least five years of relevant bookkeeping or accounting experience, including at least two years independently owning a recurring accounting cycle.
* Strong recent QuickBooks Online experience, including bank and credit\-card reconciliation, accounts payable, correcting errors and month\-end work.
* Evidence of taking ownership: setting priorities, resolving problems, coordinating others and meeting deadlines without repeated reminders.
* Practical AI experience, sound spreadsheet skills and confidence learning new systems.
* Clear written communication and good judgment when handling payments, vendor details and confidential records.
* U.S. residence and the ability to meet the stated weekday availability requirement.

Construction, trades or project\-based accounting experience is strongly preferred. QuickBooks ProAdvisor certification is helpful. Demonstrated capability matters more than a particular degree or previous job title.

**What success looks like**

During your first 90 days, you will establish a dependable weekly accounting routine, own an agreed month\-end close schedule, make outstanding issues visible, and document the core payment and reimbursement workflows. You will also implement an agreed AI\-assisted improvement and demonstrate that its output is reliable.

**How to apply**

Apply through Indeed with your résumé and brief answers to our screening questions. Specific examples of work you personally owned are more useful than broad descriptions of your strengths. Shortlisted applicants will have a focused interview and professional reference checks. No take\-home exercise is required.

Pay: $65,539\.45 \- $83,148\.59 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* Paid time off

Application Question(s):

* Describe a business whose accounting cycle you personally owned. What did you do in QuickBooks Online, roughly how many accounts or transactions did you handle, and how did you know month\-end was complete? Include how you tracked unfinished work or reviewed work completed by others. Please use 3–5 sentences.
* A $1,250 vendor bill is already in QuickBooks. Its approved credit\-card payment appears in the credit\-card feed. A colleague has also entered a separate $1,250 expense for the same purchase. What would you check, and how would you resolve it? Please use 2–4 sentences.
* A vendor payment deadline is today, but new bank details arrived by email. A crew reimbursement request is also urgent and has no receipts or project information. What would you do first, what would you hold, and what would you tell management? Please use 2–4 sentences.
* Name an AI tool you have actually used for accounting or administrative work. Describe one specific task, what it improved, and how you checked the result and handled confidential information. Please use 3–5 sentences. Do not i

jobs.title: SafePoint Implementation Specialist
jobs.description:
With a network of nearly 200 branches, Loomis armored transportation, cash management centers, and cash inventory vaults keep cash flowing throughout financial institutions and retail businesses across the US. Loomis prides itself on providing employees with opportunities for career advancement and job satisfaction. In fact, many of our company’s managers, vice presidents, and corporate executives started out in the branches as driver/guards and tellers. Our work can be challenging, but the thousands who have stayed with our company for decades will tell you that if you have the desire to learn and the drive to succeed, Loomis is the place to be. Come join our team!
  
  

**Job Overview:** This position is responsible for developing Loomis’ SafePoint product and solution configuration and managing onboarding and implementation processes for specified clients’ implementations, reporting to the Implementation Specialist Manager. This role will also manage SafePoint logistics, equipment inventory coordination, vendor ordering, and planning alignment to ensure the right devices, parts, and support materials are available for each implementation timeline.
  
  

**Accountabilities:**  

* Accountable for end\-to\-end implementation, resource scheduling, stakeholder communication, maintaining the implementation process, and ensuring timely, professional installation, implementation, and training of the SafePoint Solution.
* Engage with company and clients in a positive, professional, and proactive manner.
* Study and understand the product offering and all aspects of the solution’s implementation project plan, and become a Subject Matter Expert on SafePoint and all of its applications and permutations.
* Use all existing resources and seek additional avenues to improve your abilities and value to the company and its clients, working on personal development according to the guidelines and expectations set in your employee development plan.
* Actively ensure you meet managers' and clients' expectations, driving continuous improvement, process efficiency, and customer (internal and external) satisfaction.
* Utilize sound Project Management skills and capabilities to deliver a comprehensive and problem\-free solution implementation.
* Utilize critical communication skills and influence management techniques to motivate co\-workers, clients, and end\-user customers for the successful completion of the projects under your control.
* Coordinate SafePoint equipment logistics, including device allocation, shipment timing, delivery tracking, installation readiness, and inventory availability across implementation projects.
* Work closely with Planning, Operations, Vendors, and service partners to forecast upcoming SafePoint deployment needs and align ordering schedules with client implementation dates.
* Support vendor ordering processes by monitoring purchase requests, order status, delivery commitments, backorders, and escalation needs to prevent implementation delays.
* Maintain visibility into SafePoint implementation inventory, including units on hand, units committed to projects, units in transit, and inventory risks requiring management attention.
* Continually evaluate the implementation process, looking for better, faster, more profitable ways to sell, install, and operate the product.
* Establish and maintain exceptional client relationships at a peer level and explore additional ways that Loomis can provide value.
* Actively develop and improve upon client relationship management and engagement skills.
* Vendor management: continue to push vendors to support customers professionally and efficiently.
* Special Projects as assigned by the Product Management team.
* Other duties as assigned.


**Primary Requirements:**  

* Bachelor’s Degree or Technical institute degree/certificate in Business, Computer Science, IS, or other related field, preferred.
* Equivalent work experience in lieu of degree.
* Minimum of 5 years of operational process improvement experience required.
* Proven Project management and Quality systems implementation experience is required.
* Must have excellent communication skills.
* Ability to travel up to 10% is required.
* Ability to influence management is required.
* Experience coordinating logistics, inventory tracking, vendor ordering, or supply planning is strongly preferred.
* Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple implementation schedules, equipment requirements, and vendor follow\-ups simultaneously.


Loomis is an Equal Opportunity Employer and Drug Free Workplace. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to their race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, protected veteran status or disability.

jobs.description:
**Title:** Senior Project Manager (Non IT)
**Location:** Remote
**Job Type:** Full\-Time Exempt
**Salary:** $176,000\- $200,000 (commensurate with experience)
**Experience:** Minimum 12 years of combined engineering and project management experience
**Education:** BS degree in engineering (Civil, Mechanical, or Electrical) required
**Date Update:** September 28, 2026
**Company Description**
Now is the time to join Lindahl Reed, Inc. Lindahl Reed is a scientific, engineering, technical, and research company supporting the nation’s most critical missions in **Energy Innovation, National Security,** and **Environmental Stewardship.** At Lindahl Reed, we live our values every day. Integrity, trust, and excellence are the foundation of everything we do. We are committed to pioneering innovative solutions, enabling cutting\-edge technologies, and advancing a cleaner, and more resilient and secure world. We are hiring creative, motivated, and talented people with a passion for doing what's right, what's smart, and what works.
**Description/Job Summary**
Lindahl Reed is seeking a Senior Project Manager with deep experience in federal facility and infrastructure programs to oversee and support complex, multi\-disciplinary design\-build projects for government clients. U.S. Coast Guard (USCG) experience is strongly preferred; candidates with equivalent experience managing federal agency facility programs or large commercial design\-build programs are encouraged to apply. The ideal candidate brings senior\-level project management expertise, the ability to navigate complex government contracting environments, and a track record of delivering high\-value projects on time and within budget. Approximately 75 days per year of travel to client sites and meetings is required.
**Position Responsibilities**
* Lead multi\-million\-dollar design\-build projects as the owner’s representative or technical specialist through all phases — initiation through closeout — ensuring scope, schedule, budget, and quality objectives are met.
* Develop and manage comprehensive project plans, schedules, budgets, and risk mitigation strategies across a portfolio of technically complex federal infrastructure projects.
* Serve as primary client interface for assigned projects; build and maintain productive working relationships with government officials, Contracting Officer Representatives (CORs), and program managers.
* Lead and coordinate multidisciplinary project teams; oversee subcontractor performance and vendor relationships.
* Deliver client presentations, status reports, and strategic briefings/communications; proactively manage expectations and resolve complex project issues.
* Identify and pursue opportunities for scope additions, change orders, and follow\-on work.
* Support proposal development, capture activities, pricing strategies, and teaming arrangements.

**Qualifications, Skills, and Experience:**
* 12\+ years of combined engineering and project management experience, with progressively increasing responsibilities.
* Minimum 10 years of federal facility or infrastructure program experience. U.S. Coast Guard experience is strongly preferred; equivalent experience with other federal agencies (e.g., NOAA, USACE, Navy) or large commercial design\-build programs will be considered.
* Demonstrated track record managing design\-build construction projects exceeding $5M in value, from procurement through construction completion.
* Experience with maritime or waterfront infrastructure programs is a plus.
* Owner's Representative experience is highly desirable.
* Bachelor’s degree in engineering (Civil, Mechanical, or Electrical) required.
* Professional Engineering (PE) license required.
* Project Management Professional (PMP) certification required.
* Design\-Build Institute of America (DBIA) certification is a plus.
* Proficiency with project management tools (MS Project, Primavera, Smartsheet, or similar).
* Working knowledge of federal acquisition regulations (FAR), government contracting processes, and federal engineering standards.
* Understanding of federal agency organizational structures and interagency coordination
* US Citizenship is required.
* Ability to pass a government\-administered background investigation in order to be granted a Common Access Card and access to government IT systems.

**Benefits**
The following benefits are available to benefit\-eligible employees (working 30\+ hours per week):
* Medical Benefits
* Dental Benefits
* Vision Benefits
* Retirement Plan
* Company paid Basic Life, Long\-Term Disability and Short\-Term Disability
* Flexible Spending Account
* Paid Time Off/ 11 Federal Holidays
* Professional and Educational Development
* And other benefits

All positions require a background check after acceptance of our offer. The selected candidate may be eligible to begin employment before the background check has been finalized. However, continued employment with Lindahl Reed will be contingent upon the timely and acceptable results of candidate’s reference/background check. This position may require special credentialing, clearance, and access as a condition of employment. In the event the government or client does not sponsor or approve your credentialing and/ or clearance, it may result in termination of your employment.
Lindahl Reed is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, pregnancy, genetic information, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any other protected category under applicable federal, state, and local laws.
Lindahl Reed complies with pay disclosure requirements for applicable cities and states.
This job description is not a contract and may be adjusted as deemed appropriate in Lindahl Reed’s sole discretion.

Ensign Services, Inc. This position primarily involves working remotely or in an office.

Final determination of a successful candidate’s starting pay will vary based on a number of factors, including market location and may vary depending on job\-related knowledge, skills, education and experience. The pay scale listed for this position is generally for candidates that meet the specified qualifications and requirements listed on this specific job description. We provide a competitive compensation package that recognizes your experience, credentials, and education alongside a robust benefits program to meet your needs. Our compensation reflects the cost of labor across several US geographic markets.**WHO WE ARE**  

Since 1954, Cupertino Electric, Inc. (CEI)has been powered by people who’ve built a reputation for delivering high\-profile, complex projects. Real, tangible things that alter the landscape and improve lives. And we've done it with integrity for more than 70 years. We’re problem solvers and innovation seekers. We’re team players and safety fanatics. And we're proud to be part of Quanta Services (PWR:NYSE), North America's largest employer of skilled craft labor. Because what we do is important, but how we do it is everything.
**THE ENERGY TEAM**
Our Energy Group at CEI builds projects from the field to the grid. Whether it’s a solar, battery storage, substation, EV charging, microgrid or converter station project, our skilled project managers, engineers and field employees deliver when it matters most. We work with customers on programs of all sizes—those spanning several smaller sites or spanning several thousand acres. Besides building some of the nation’s largest utility\-scale solar plants and installing more EV charging stations in California than any other contractor, we are dedicated to running a business that is environmentally responsible.
**ABOUT THE ROLE**
At Cupertino Electric, **Assistant Project Managers (APM)** are key to coordination between the field team, project team, and our customers. By partnering with the Project Manager, the APM will learn the processes and witness the critical thinking required for approaching our projects from a strategic lens. The APM will gain a deep understanding of CEI’s scope of work on a project. Additionally, they contribute to, review, and track project activities including change orders, submittals, tracking logs, and related project documents.
* Lead team meetings and provide guidance to Project Engineers and Project Coordinators in partnership with the Project Manager, Production Manager, field team and Trade Partners.
* Identifies cost and schedule impacts associated with RFIs, submittals, and design changes and provides timely notification.
* Prices change orders consistently and in a timely manner for project manager review and approval.
* Develops and manages close out documents as the Project progresses.
* Coordinate commissioning activities w/ 3rd party. Tracks and follows up on open items.
* Maintain strong working partnerships with vendors and subcontractors. Coordinates accurate material releases on time and consistent with project documents. Track material releases, changes and coordinate delivery with construction schedule.

**ABOUT YOU*** Serve as the go\-to person to help resolve any issues or potential problem areas.
* Actively thinks about new ways to improve or change processes. Brings innovative and entrepreneurial thinking to a project.
* Prior experience working on semi\-remote jobsites, supervising others. Renewables/Large Electrical/Data Center build experience highly desired.
* Good working knowledge of MS applications including Excel.
* Prior experience in electrical estimating and the ability to accurately estimate change order pricing.
* Knowledge of Electrical Code and Civil Construction.

**WHAT YOU WILL GAIN**
As an Assistant Project Manager (APM) at Cupertino Electric, you will be empowered to learn the skills and competencies required to become a successful Project Manager. APMs have the opportunity to execute Project Manager level activities within the safety of the larger Project Team. This is when all of the deep, technical, and process\-guided learning comes into play. Partnered with a Project Manager, through practice and feedback, you will learn the processes, and witness the critical thinking required for strategic project approach, which will in turn set you up for a successful future on your career path. You will be interacting extensively with the CEI Production Team, customers, and vendor and subcontractor partners, giving you opportunities to cultivate relationships and build your professional network.
**MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS***Any combination of education and experience that, in the sole judgment and discretion of Company, would likely provide the required knowledge, skills and abilities as well as possession of any required licenses or certifications may qualify.***Education:** High School Diploma or GED required. Bachelor’s Degree in Construction Management, Business, Engineering, or similar preferred.
**Licensure/Certifications:** None required.
**Experience:** Three (3\) or more years of experience specifically as a Project Engineer in electrical construction (Renewable Energy preferred) or MEP/Civil/Structural experience in general contracting. Minimum five (5\)\+ years of related experience, including some time managing smaller projects.
**Driving Record:** Valid state\-issued driver’s license and satisfactory driving record.
* Applicants must be authorized to work in the United States. This position is not eligible for sponsorship.

jobs.description:
About ¡WEPA! líbros®

¡WEPA! líbros® partners with schools and public libraries to expand access to authentic books in the languages their communities speak. We design curated collections around each client’s educational goals and source books internationally to bring those collections to life.

About the Role

You will own assigned collection projects from the approved client brief through the handoff to purchasing. You’ll direct and review curation, resolve gaps, track deadlines, and make sure each collection is accurate and ready to order.

We’re looking for someone with strong judgment about multilingual literature who is equally strong at moving work forward. In this remote role, you’ll keep project records current, make decisions within your scope, and communicate early when a deadline or requirement is at risk.

What You’ll Do

* Turn client goals, age levels, languages, budget, and collection priorities into clear direction for curators.
* Assign and review curation work, checking both individual titles and the balance of the collection as a whole.
* Catch and resolve issues involving age fit, genre, language, cultural relevance, ISBNs, formats, duplication, inventory, and availability.
* Curate titles directly when a project requires it.
* Maintain clear project synopses, status updates, and outstanding decisions.
* Coordinate changes and substitutions with purchasing.
* Deliver complete purchasing handoffs on time, with unresolved issues identified and addressed.
* Communicate directly with clients about collection direction and approvals when assigned.

What You’ll Bring

* Experience in collection development, children’s literature, school or public libraries, curriculum materials, publishing, or a related field.
* A track record of managing detailed projects and meeting deadlines without close supervision.
* The ability to review a collection against a brief and make specific, defensible corrections.
* Strong spreadsheet skills and close attention to book data.
* Clear written communication and good judgment about when to act, collaborate, or escalate.
* Reliable availability and follow\-through in a remote role.

Spanish proficiency is helpful. Experience working with multilingual collections is welcome, but the ability to manage collection quality and project execution is essential.

This is a part\-time W\-2 position with scheduled weekly availability.

Job Type: Contract

Pay: $22\.00 \- $27\.00 per hour

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule

Application Question(s):

* A collection is due to purchasing on Friday. On Wednesday, you discover that several books do not meet the client’s grade\-level requirements, and the curator’s list is incomplete. You have other projects due that week. In 150 words or fewer, tell us what you would do before the end of Wednesday, what you would communicate, and how you would protect the Friday handoff.

Work Location: Remote

We employ modern best practices in all that we do as we work to solve problems in public health, financial industry regulation, granting citizenship and asylum, and identity and access management.

**About the Role**: Pluribus Digital is seeking a **Deputy Program Manager (DPM)** to join our team supporting a high\-impact federal contract with the Department of the Treasury. This role is ideal for someone with strong program management experience who thrives in fast\-paced, agile environments and wants to help modernize mission\-critical systems that directly serve the public.

As DPM, you will play a vital role in overseeing day\-to\-day operations across multiple Agile delivery teams. You'll serve as a key liaison between client stakeholders and cross\-functional teams, supporting the Program Manager in strategic execution, delivery quality, and team performance. You'll help guide operational processes, remove blockers, align staffing needs, and ensure delivery excellence while fostering a culture of trust, accountability, and continuous improvement.

* Track program health metrics including burn rate, contract deliverables, and team capacity.

* Help shape overall delivery strategy and ensure alignment across teams.

* Serve as a resource for team\-wide agile best practices (Scrum, Kanban, SAFe) and help remove blockers.

* Facilitate information flow between the program manager, government stakeholders, leadership, and Pluribus teams.

* Prepare program summaries and performance reports; support compliance with contract terms, timelines, and deliverables.

* Collaborate with recruiters and delivery leadership to forecast, plan, and fulfill staffing needs.
* Support interviews, onboarding, and performance management for new hires.

**What you will bring:**
* Must be able to obtain and maintain a Public Trust Clearance.
* PMP certification.
* 5\+ years experience in program or project management within large\-scale federal contracts.
* Proven experience leading Agile software delivery, DevOps, or data\-focused teams.
* Experience supporting cross\-functional teams with matrixed reporting structures.
* Strong communication, relationship\-building, and leadership skills.
* Knowledge of federal budget and procurement processes.

**Preferred Qualifications:**
* Experience in a technical role (e.g., software engineering, DevOps, systems, or data).
* Agile certifications (Scrum Master, Product Owner, SAFe).
* Experience working in blended sprint and Kanban delivery models.
* Experience supporting Government contracts.
* Proactive, self\-motivated, and results\-driven.
* Strong facilitation and conflict\-resolution skills.
**Why Pluribus May Be a Fit for You:**



We are purpose driven. We support missions and products that serve the public good, and where our focused capabilities positively impact those mission outcomes. We bring a consultative approach to partner with our government customers and help them succeed as change makers.



Pluribus is a calm company. We are knowledge workers. People do their best work when they are not rushed by artificial urgency or drained by a culture of facetime and workaholism. jobs.description:
**Cybersecurity Project Manager**
* Are you a tech enthusiast who loves solving complex problems?
* Do you have a keen eye for detail and excellent analytical skills?
* Would your friends describe you as a self\-starter who takes pride in your work and enjoys collaborating with others?

If so, we have an exciting opportunity for you at The Greentree Group!
**WHO WE ARE**
The Greentree Group is a dynamic, innovative, and thriving company that specializes in delivering advanced technology solutions to federal, state, and commercial clients. With a team of highly skilled professionals, we provide cutting\-edge services and are always pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.
What sets us apart is our commitment to excellence and our passion for the work we do. At The Greentree Group, we are driven by a shared sense of purpose and a desire to make a difference in the lives of people around us. Whether it's helping our clients achieve their goals, developing innovative solutions to complex problems, or giving back to the community, we are dedicated to making a positive impact.
We also believe in investing in our people and providing them with opportunities for growth, development, and advancement. We offer a dynamic and supportive work environment, a culture of continuous learning, and a wide range of benefits and perks that promote work\-life balance and personal well\-being.
Whether you're a seasoned expert or just starting out in your career, if you're passionate about technology, committed to excellence, and eager to take on new challenges, we want to hear from you!
**ABOUT THE OPPORTUNITY**
The Greentree Group values its employees and fosters a collaborative environment where talented professionals can thrive. We are seeking an experienced **Cybersecurity Project Manager** to lead a complex cybersecurity assessment program supporting a public sector client in Austin, TX.
This role will be responsible for planning, managing, and overseeing cybersecurity assessment activities conducted in accordance with CMS security and privacy requirements, including the Acceptable Risk Controls for ACA, Medicaid, and Partner Entities (ARC\-AMPE) framework and applicable NIST standards. The successful candidate will lead assessment teams, manage project schedules and deliverables, coordinate stakeholder communications, and ensure the successful execution of security assessment and authorization activities.
The ideal candidate is a proactive leader who can effectively manage technical teams, communicate with executive stakeholders, translate complex cybersecurity concepts into actionable recommendations, and drive projects to successful completion while maintaining the highest standards of quality and compliance.
**SOME RESPONSIBILITIES INCLUDE BUT ARE NOT LIMITED TO:**
Cybersecurity risks continue to evolve, creating increasingly complex challenges for government agencies responsible for safeguarding sensitive information and critical services. As a Cybersecurity Project Manager, you will play a key role in helping clients understand, assess, and mitigate these risks through structured assessment, compliance, and risk management activities.
**Key responsibilities include:**
* Lead the planning, execution, and delivery of cybersecurity assessment projects, ensuring adherence to contractual requirements, schedules, budgets, and quality standards.
* Manage multidisciplinary assessment teams responsible for evaluating administrative, technical, and operational security controls.
* Coordinate security assessment activities conducted under CMS ARC\-AMPE, NIST SP 800\-53, and other applicable federal and state cybersecurity requirements.
* Develop and maintain project management artifacts, including project schedules, risk registers, status reports, action item logs, and executive briefings.
* Facilitate meetings and communication between client leadership, technical stakeholders, assessors, and other project participants.
* Oversee the development and delivery of assessment documentation, including Security Assessment Plans (SAPs), Security Assessment Reports (SARs), Plan of Action and Milestones (POA\&Ms), and other required deliverables.
* Identify project risks, issues, dependencies, and resource constraints, and develop appropriate mitigation strategies.
* Present technical findings, compliance gaps, and risk\-based recommendations to both technical and executive audiences.
* Support continuous improvement efforts by identifying opportunities to enhance assessment methodologies, project execution processes, and client outcomes.
* Ensure project teams maintain compliance with established cybersecurity, privacy, and quality assurance requirements.
* The successful candidate will serve as a trusted advisor to the client, helping leadership understand cybersecurity risks, prioritize remediation efforts, and make informed decisions regarding the protection of critical systems and sensitive data.

**MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS:**
* Strong verbal, written, and presentation skills.

**Job Description:**


This role will support the NASA Office of the Chief Human Capital Office (OCHCO) in the implementation of the Office of Personnel Management (OPM) Federal HR 2\.0 initiative by managing meetings, organizing working groups, coordinating OPM data call responses, maintaining communication with OPM and NASA stakeholders, and keeping leadership informed through streamlined tracking, reporting, and documentation. -----------------------



With direction from the QA Inspection Supervisor(s) and Quality Management perform dimensional inspections on machined and molded components manufactured from internal and external sources per engineering drawings and applicable external standards. Maintains inspection equipment including Vertex and Vectors. Also maintains control of products on hold.

Perform first article and final product inspections working from engineering drawings, procedures, and external standards, using typical inspection equipment such as micrometers, thread gauges, calipers, optical comparator, concentricity gauge, and height \& depth gages.


Perform receiving inspection of Finished Goods and components using typical inspection equipment.

Ability to use typical measuring devices (micrometer, caliper, comparator, thread gages, go/nogo gages and custom gages) and test instruments (pull and torque testers).

**What is Bilt?**
Bilt is the membership for where you live.  

  

What started as a way to reward people on their largest expense has turned into an ecosystem connecting our members, property managers and local merchants.
Travel, dining, fitness, everyday spend. We are building systems across payments, credit, loyalty, and commerce all at once.  

  

We run lean and move quickly. Every person here has a real impact on what gets built and how fast it happens.  

  

This role comes with real ownership and high expectations. If you prefer clearly defined lanes and structure, this will feel uncomfortable. If you want to build quickly, have a real say in what gets built, and work on products used by millions, you will likely do your best work here.
**What's the role?**
As a **Customer Support Team Member**, you will serve as the first point of contact for our members through chat support and handling support tickets. **Please note, this role will require to work a weekend schedule.** We will provide comprehensive training to ensure you are thoroughly knowledgeable about our product, enabling you to offer our members exceptional support and resolve their initial inquiries with care.  

  

**\*\*This position has a start date of November 9th, 2026\. All new hires are required to attend in\-person onboarding training in New York City for their first week (November 8\-13, 2026\). Training will continue for an additional 4 weeks and requires full\-time availability from Monday \- Friday, 9AM to 6PM ET with 100% attendance. Candidates with pre\-scheduled commitments or availability conflicts during these hours will not be eligible for this cohort.\*\***  

  

**In this role, you will…**
* Respond to member inquiries through our chat platform as the first line of support
* Handle entry\-level support tickets related to payment, loyalty, and general questions within the Bilt Rewards platform
* Triage incoming tickets, identify emerging trends, and escalate complex issues to relevant internal departments
* Document member interactions and escalate ongoing patterns to senior team members
* Collaborate remotely with internal teams and our BPO partners to address and resolve member issues effectively
* Develop a deep understanding of our products, features, and services through comprehensive training programs
* Stay updated on new product releases and enhancements to effectively communicate benefits to members as the company scales
* Maintain organization and patience while understanding the specifics of each member's needs and the unique nuances of each partner's business operations
* Adapt to diverse business models and tailor your support approach to meet individual member needs
* Provide exceptional customer service through digital channels, even when handling complex inquiries
  

  

**In terms of qualifications, we’re seeking:**
* 0\-2\+ years of professional experience in customer support, operations, or related field
* Extremely organized with strong written and verbal skills.
* A team player who’s able to learn new platforms quickly and is patient and adaptable in a fast\-paced environment.
* Driven to take on new responsibilities, with an ability to stay focused on assigned tasks.
* Strong attention to detail with the intelligence to use critical thinking for solutions. Flexibility \- We are disrupting an industry so changes to traditional processes should be expected.
* Ability to deal with extremely confidential and sensitive information.
  

  

**Benefits:**
* **Compensation** \- We offer a competitive salary with a meaningful stake in the company via equity and our performance bonus program
* **Health insurance for you (\& your loved ones) from day one** \- Enjoy a One Medical Membership, wellness stipends, family programs and more, on us. We’ve got you and your family covered from day one.

At Bilt, we believe in transparency and we do our best to make sure the company and our candidates are on the same page as it relates to compensation. In addition to posting salary ranges for our open roles, candidates should expect to be asked about compensation expectations and requirements early on in their interview process. Our goal is to highlight when expectations and Bilt’s salary range may be out of sync, and work with the candidate to determine whether it makes sense to continue conversations.  

  

We are considering candidates with differing levels of expertise for this position. Leveling will be based upon your experience and performance in the interview process.  

  

Where a new hire falls within a range will be based on their individual skills and experience, and how these competencies compare across other employees in the same role. Bilt's bands are designed to allow for individual compensation growth within the role. As such, new hires typically start at the lower end of the range. Bilt rewards performance and outcomes \- should you join the company, you will have the opportunity to grow your salary over time.

jobs.title: Compliance Program Manager
jobs.description:
Stord is The Consumer Experience Company, powering seamless checkout through delivery for today's leading brands. Stord is rapidly growing and is on track to double our revenue in the next 18 months. To meet and exceed this target, Stord is strategically scaling teams across the entire company, and seeking energetic experts to help us achieve our mission.


By combining comprehensive commerce\-enablement technology with high\-volume fulfillment services, Stord provides brands a platform to compete with retail giants. Stord manages over $10 billion of commerce annually through its fulfillment, warehousing, transportation, and operator\-built software suite including OMS, Pre\- and Post\-Purchase, and WMS platforms. Stord is leveling the playing field for all brands to deliver the best consumer experience at scale.


With Stord, brands can increase cart conversion, improve unit economics, and drive sustained customer loyalty. Stord’s end\-to\-end commerce solutions combine best\-in\-class omnichannel fulfillment and shipping with leading technology to ensure fast shipping, reliable delivery promises, easy access to more channels, and improved margins on every order.


Hundreds of leading DTC and B2B companies like AG1, True Classic, Native, Seed Health, quip, goodr, Sundays for Dogs, and more trust Stord to deliver industry\-leading consumer experiences on every order. Stord is headquartered in Atlanta with facilities across the United States, Canada, and Europe. Stord is backed by top\-tier investors including Kleiner Perkins, Franklin Templeton, Founders Fund, Strike Capital, Baillie Gifford, and Salesforce Ventures.


Role Overview
  

The Program Manager, Compliance is a strategic driver of Stord’s operational strength and commercial growth. This role is responsible for scaling enterprise compliance programs across OSHA, EPA, GMP, and adjacent regulatory regimes \- building the infrastructure that enables Stord to operate with confidence, win in the market, and deliver on the compliance commitments that today’s leading brands require from a fulfillment partner. A mature, well\-run compliance program is not just a risk management function at Stord; it is a competitive differentiator that unlocks customer revenue, supports network expansion, and protects the business at scale.
  

  

Reporting to the Director of Health, Safety \& Security, this is an enterprise\-level, network\-wide role that operates at the intersection of compliance, operations, and growth. The Program Manager partners closely with Sales, Customer Success, Operations, and Finance to ensure compliance capabilities are a strength Stord leads with \- enabling the business to pursue regulated customer segments, scale into new markets, and demonstrate the program maturity that top\-tier brands demand. The work product of this role is what the entire organization is built around: scalable written programs, audit frameworks, certification standards, reporting infrastructure, and regulatory intelligence systems that grow stronger as Stord grows.
**What This Role Owns**
=======================

This role owns the enterprise compliance program architecture \- the standards, written programs, audit frameworks, and governance mechanisms that define what ‘compliant’ looks like at every Stord facility. The work product of this role is what the rest of the organization is held accountable to. Specifically:


* Enterprise compliance program design, construction, and ownership across OSHA, EPA, GMP, GDP, DOT, and applicable state and local regulatory frameworks \- building programs from the ground up where gaps exist and elevating inconsistent standards to enterprise\-grade.
* Regulatory intelligence: continuously monitoring rulemaking, agency guidance, and enforcement trends; converting regulatory change into updated enterprise programs before gaps become violations.
* Enterprise audit and inspection framework: designing the internal audit program architecture, defining scope and methodology, and building the tools and cadences that keep the network inspection\-ready \- not conducting site audits, but building the system that governs them.
* Enterprise compliance documentation infrastructure: designing and owning the system of record for all written programs, SOPs, training requirements, certifications, and regulatory correspondence \- the single source of truth for compliance across the network.
* Customer and industry certification programs: GMP, GDP, CTPAT, TAPA, and other regulated operating standards required by Stord’s customer base.
* Regulatory agency relationships: serving as the primary compliance point of contact for OSHA, EPA, and other agencies at the program level.
* Enterprise compliance reporting, data, and dashboards: building the metrics infrastructure that gives the Head of HSS, senior leadership, and the broader business real\-time visibility into compliance performance, risk posture, and program health across the network.
* Enterprise compliance training architecture: defining what training is required, for whom, at what frequency, and in what format \- building the content and governance framework that regional and site teams deliver against.

**Key Responsibilities**
========================

**OSHA Compliance Program Management**
--------------------------------------

* Build and own Stord’s enterprise OSHA compliance program \- designing the written program architecture, establishing network\-wide standards, and creating the governance mechanisms that ensure consistent compliance across every facility regardless of size, volume, or operational complexity.
* Maintain and update OSHA\-required written programs: Hazard Communication, Lockout/Tagout, Respiratory Protection, Emergency Action Plans, Powered Industrial Truck programs, and others as applicable.
* Oversee OSHA recordkeeping standards across the network \- establishing recordkeeping protocols, auditing site\-level logs for accuracy, and managing 300A

jobs.title: REMOTE Learning Program Manager, International Programs
jobs.description:
**REMOTE Learning Program Manager, International Programs**

The future of learning deserves the right talent. CapeTalent connects AI\-forward Learning \& Development professionals with Fortune 100 companies driving innovation at scale.


**CONTRACT DETAILS**W2 employment is not available for this engagement.
* 1099/C2C Only
* **EST HOURS**
* 6\-month contract (strong likelihood of extension)
* **REMOTE**
* Start date: October 2026
* 40 hours per week @ $55\-$65/hour (C2C or 1099\), based on experience
* Standard U.S. business hours
* Heavy Slack collaboration \+ Laptop provided
* **EST Hours**
* **Portfolio REQUIRED**


**The Opportunity**

As Learning Program Manager, International Programs, you'll design and manage the training programs that prepare our Experts in the UK, Canada, and Australia, and keep them in step with our US programs. When the US training changes, you'll decide what each international program needs, design the solution, and work with our Instructional Designers to bring it to life.


This role blends learning design and program management. You'll use your instructional design skills to shape learning journeys that build real job skills, and your organizational skills to keep many updates moving across three regions. It's a great fit for someone who is organized, detail\-oriented, and enjoys working with a team spread across time zones. If you've designed and managed training, onboarding, or enablement programs and have experience with accounting or bookkeeping software, we'd love to hear from you.


**What You'll Do**

**Keeping Programs Aligned Across Markets**

* Keep an eye on changes to US training and assess how they affect the UK, Canadian, and Australian programs.
* Compare US and international programs to identify content that needs to be updated, adapted for the local market, added, or removed.
* Tell the difference between product changes that apply everywhere and local differences (e.g., tax, payroll, compliance, and terminology) so each program stays accurate for its learners.
* Keep a clear, current view of where each international program stands compared with the US version.

**Designing Learning Programs**

* Conduct needs analyses to define clear, measurable, performance\-based learning outcomes tied to job success.
* Design learning journeys, curricula, and course outlines for international learners, including onboarding, product, and process training.
* Apply instructional design methods (e.g., ADDIE, SAM) and adult learning principles to build engaging, accessible learning with meaningful practice and scenarios.
* Design assessments and knowledge checks that confirm learners are ready for the job.

**Working with Instructional Designers**

* Turn identified gaps into clear, prioritized update requests for the Instructional Design team.
* Give designers the context, source materials, and expectations they need to make changes efficiently.
* Review updated content for accuracy and consistency before it goes live.

**Program Management**

* Manage updates from start to finish: intake, prioritization, scheduling, tracking, review, and launch.
* Juggle timelines and workloads across multiple updates at once using project trackers and checklists.
* Build and improve repeatable processes for keeping international programs in sync with the US.
* Spot bottlenecks early and suggest practical fixes.

**Stakeholder Communication**

* Serve as the main point of contact between US and international learning teams.
* Work Eastern Time hours to collaborate in real time with overseas teammates.
* Share progress, risks, and milestones clearly with leadership and partner teams, and raise issues early.

**Measuring Results \& Improving**

* Track program metrics such as content accuracy, learner engagement, completion, and effectiveness across regions.
* Gather and act on feedback from learners and stakeholders in each market.
* Keep program documentation, course materials, and change records up to date in the LMS and related systems.

**Qualifications**

**Must\-Have**

* Experience managing learning or training programs end to end (e.g., Learning Program Manager, Training Manager, L\&D Program Manager, Enablement Manager, or similar).
* Strong instructional design skills: needs analysis, learning objectives, curriculum and course design, and applying adult learning principles.
* Hands\-on experience with accounting or bookkeeping software, whether as a user, trainer, support specialist, bookkeeper, or accountant.
* Located on the US East Coast, or able to consistently work Eastern Time hours to align with our overseas team.

**Nice to Have**

* Experience managing programs or projects that involve several teams or departments.
* Experience with training programs for more than one country or region, or adapting content for different audiences.
* Familiarity with tax, bookkeeping, accounting, or payroll, especially differences between the US, UK, Canada, and Australia.
* Experience leading or partnering with Instructional Designers and eLearning developers.
* Experience with training for customer support, service, or other customer\-facing teams.
* Experience with any LMS or learning platform (e.g., Degreed, Docebo, Credly, Cornerstone, Workday Learning), and authoring tools such as Articulate Rise or Storyline.
* Comfortable with project tracking tools (e.g., Jira, Asana, Smartsheet) and Agile or similar ways of working.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills and experience working with remote, distributed teams.
* Bachelor's degree required; a Master's in Instructional Design, Education, Business, or a related field is a plus.

Findem is the AI platform for talent outcomes. Its Labeling Engine transforms billions of unstructured people data points into verified Success Signals — context about what drives success — and Relationship Signals — insight into how people are connected and where influence flows. Together, these give customers a competitive edge in hiring, executive search, mobility, learning, development and workforce planning. That’s why leaders rely on Findem to improve pipeline quality, reduce costs, and deliver faster, more consistent talent impact. Named one of America’s Most Innovative Companies, Findem is redefining how organizations turn people data into business advantage.

The Senior CSM will directly manage a portfolio of Findem’s largest and most strategic customers while also serving as an overlay and advisor across the broader customer base. This role will drive consistency, foresight, and cross\-functional alignment in how Findem delivers value and mitigates risk across all accounts.


The Senior Customer Success Manager owns the operational relationship \- including success planning and business objectives alignment and attainment for a portfolio of Findem's enterprise customers. The role exists to protect and grow recurring revenue by ensuring each customer realizes measurable value from the Findem platform — faster time to hire, stronger pipeline quality, improved candidate quality, and greater recruiter productivity — and by identifying and resolving risk well before it reaches a renewal decision.


Operating as the customer's primary strategic product partner, the Senior CSM translates each customer's talent strategy into an executable success plan, drives adoption across Findem's offerings, and serves as the customer's internal advocate across Product, Marketing, Support, and Implementation. Accountability sits with retention, adoption depth, reference\-ability, and expansion readiness across the assigned book.

**Adoption and value realization**

Keeper’s cybersecurity software is trusted by millions of people and thousands of organizations globally. Keeper is published in 23 languages and is sold in over 150 countries. Join one of the fastest\-growing cybersecurity companies and help improve the systems, processes, and resources that support successful customer implementations.


**About Keeper**



Keeper Security is one of the fastest\-growing cybersecurity software companies that protects thousands of organizations and millions of people in over 150 countries. Responsible for supporting and enhancing LifeBalance client relationships. Focuses on supporting account executives by handling day\-to\-day tasks needed to maintain client relationships, and working on various client/member/vendor onboarding, engagement, and communications needs.

Zeta Global (NYSE: ZETA) is the AI\-Powered Marketing Cloud that leverages advanced artificial intelligence (AI) and trillions of consumer signals to make it easier for marketers to acquire, grow, and retain customers more efficiently. Through the Zeta Marketing Platform (ZMP), our vision is to make sophisticated marketing simple by unifying identity, intelligence, and omnichannel activation into a single platform – powered by one of the industry’s largest proprietary databases and AI. Our enterprise customers across multiple verticals are empowered to personalize experiences with consumers at an individual level across every channel, delivering better results for marketing programs. Zeta was founded in 2007 by David A. Steinberg and John Sculley and is headquartered in New York City with offices around the world. To learn more, go to www.zetaglobal.com.


**About the Role**



We are looking for a results\-oriented Customer Success Manager to drive client outcomes and revenue growth across our publisher (Supply) partners.



In this role, you will own a portfolio of accounts end\-to\-end, responsible for renewals, expansion, and long\-term partner value. You will act as a strategic advisor to your clients, aligning Zeta’s solutions to their business goals while ensuring strong platform adoption and measurable performance.



You will operate with clear accountability to revenue targets, pipeline development, and account health, while maintaining a high bar for client experience. This role requires a balance of strategic thinking, operational discipline, and proactive client engagement.


**What** **You’ll** **Do**


**Own Revenue \& Account Growth**


* Own a book of business with accountability for renewals, upsell, and cross\-sell within existing publisher accounts
* Build and manage a pipeline of expansion opportunities; maintain visibility into account growth and pacing to goals
* Monitor account performance against forecasts and identify risks and opportunities early


**Drive Strategic Client Engagement**


* Serve as the primary point of contact and trusted advisor for assigned accounts
* Lead client communications including business reviews (QBRs/ABRs/SBRs), performance updates, and strategic planning sessions
* Develop a deep understanding of partner KPIs, monetization strategies, and success metrics


**Deliver Performance \& Insights**


* Analyze campaign and platform performance to provide proactive, data\-driven recommendations
* Identify optimization opportunities and drive execution in partnership with internal teams
* Translate data into clear, actionable insights that align with client goals


**Lead Account Operations \& Execution**


* Own account planning, reporting, and overall account health tracking
* Maintain strong Salesforce hygiene including opportunity tracking, forecasting inputs, and activity documentation
* Lead platform demos, onboarding, and training sessions to drive adoption and value realization


**Collaborate Cross\-Functionally**


* Partner with Sales, Supply Operations, Product, and Support teams to deliver consistent client outcomes
* Support RFP responses and strategic opportunities in partnership with Sales
* Surface client feedback and insights to inform product and operational improvements


Requirements


* 4–7\+ years of experience in Customer Success, Account Management, or Publisher Partnerships (Supply Side)
* Demonstrated ability to drive renewals and grow revenue within existing accounts
* Strong client\-facing presence with the ability to influence both day\-to\-day and executive stakeholders
* Experience managing multiple accounts with competing priorities and deadlines
* Data\-driven mindset with the ability to translate performance into strategic recommendations
* Strong operational discipline, including experience with CRM tools (Salesforce preferred) and pipeline tracking
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills


**Preferred:**


* Experience in digital media, ad tech, or publisher ecosystems
* Understanding of Ad Serving, CRM data/audiences, Ad Tags, and Email Service Providers (ESP)
* Basic understanding of HTML and campaign setup processes


**BENEFITS \& PERKS**


* Unlimited PTO
* Excellent medical, dental, and vision coverage
* Employee Equity
* Employee Discounts, Virtual Wellness Classes, and Pet Insurance And more!!


**SALARY RANGE**



The salary range for this role is **$110,000 \- $120,000\.00****,** depending on location and experience.


**PEOPLE \& CULTURE AT ZETA**



Zeta considers applicants for employment without regard to, and does not discriminate on the basis of an individual’s sex, race, color, religion, age, disability, status as a veteran, or national or ethnic origin; nor does Zeta discriminate on the basis of sexual orientation, gender identity or expression.


We’re committed to building a workplace culture of trust and belonging, so everyone feels invited to bring their whole selves to work. We provide a forum for employees to celebrate, support and advocate for one another. Learn more about our commitment to diversity, equity and inclusion here: https://zetaglobal.com/blog/a\-look\-into\-zetas\-ergs/

https://zetaglobal.com/press/?cat\=press\-releases

jobs.title: Business Analyst
jobs.description:
WorldClinic, Inc. is redefining healthcare, delivering physician\-led, immediate\-access care that achieves exceptional clinical outcomes and strong financial returns.

  

Through our two platforms, we serve both ends of the workforce: **WorldClinic** provides 24/7 connected healthcare to globally mobile executives and business leaders, resolving the majority of medical issues in a single call. **JobSiteCare** has redefined occupational health for employers with frontline and at\-risk workforces through a combination of telemedicine and on\-site medics, delivering end\-to\-end case management from injury through return\-to\-work – resulting in significant reductions in OSHA recordables and workers’ compensation claim costs.

  

Together, we deliver clinical excellence and measurable outcomes at scale, for any patient population, anywhere.

  

Just as deeply as we care for the patients we serve, we invest in our own team. You'll find a mission\-driven culture that values contribution, encourages growth, and empowers employees to do meaningful work.

  

Offers of employment are contingent upon the successful completion of a comprehensive background check (and for Health and Wellness Specialist positions a pre\-employment drug screen). WorldClinic, Inc (and its affiliates) is a drug\-free workplace and complies with all applicable federal and state laws regarding testing. Refusal to submit to a test or failure to meet the requirements of the background check will result in the withdrawal of the employment offer.

 **Business Analyst**

**Location:** Remote (United States) – *Must be available during Eastern Time core hours*

**Job Type:** Full\-time, Exempt

**Department:** Product Management

**About Us:**  

Join WorldClinic and JobSiteCare, physician\-led companies redefining healthcare delivery through immediate\-access care and occupational health innovation. We are a mission\-driven culture that values contribution, encourages growth, and empowers employees to do meaningful work. We're looking for a proactive Business Analyst to sit at the center of our product and technology work, translating how our business operates into clear requirements our development teams can build against.

**About the Role:**

* Serve as the connective tissue between business stakeholders and technical teams, translating clinical, operational, and commercial needs into technical realities.
* Elicit and document clear business requirements through stakeholder interviews, workflow observation, and collaborative working sessions.
* Map current\-state and future\-state processes, identifying gaps, redundancies, and clear automation opportunities.
* Write unambiguous user stories with testable acceptance criteria, partnering with QA and engineering to eliminate guesswork before development begins.
* Maintain and groom the product backlog alongside product managers by writing, refining, and prioritizing work items.
* Support data migration and system integration efforts, including field mapping, data validation rules, reconciliation, and cutover readiness.
* Facilitate user acceptance testing (UAT) by building test scenarios, coordinating business testers, and tracking defect resolution to closure.
* Produce and maintain critical supporting documentation, including process maps, data dictionaries, release notes, and end\-user training materials.
* Contribute actively to sprint ceremonies (planning, standup, review, retrospective) to keep delivery status visible and honest.

**Ideal Candidates:**

* **Experienced:** 3\+ years as a Business Analyst, Systems Analyst, or in a comparable requirements\-focused role.
* **Agile\-Savvy:** Demonstrated experience writing user stories and managing backlogs using tools like Jira, Azure DevOps, or equivalent.
* **Analytical:** Strong process mapping skills with fluency in diagramming tools like Lucidchart, Visio, or similar.
* **Communicator:** Exceptional written and verbal skills, with the ability to produce documentation that a busy executive and a software developer will both find highly useful.
* **Organized:** Proven ability to manage competing priorities across multiple concurrent workstreams without dropping threads.
* **Collaborative:** A track record of working effectively in a distributed team with proactive communication and comfort driving alignment over video and text.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience in healthcare, digital health, EHR/EMR systems, or regulated environments (HIPAA, SOC 2\).
* Experience supporting a platform migration, major system implementation, or API\-based integrations.
* Exposure to behavior\-driven development (BDD) and Gherkin\-style (Given/When/Then) acceptance criteria.
* Bachelor's degree in Business, Information Systems, Healthcare Administration, or equivalent practical experience.

**Physical Requirements:**

* Must be able to remain in a stationary seated or standing position for up to 8 hours daily while working on a computer.
* Must be able to operate a computer, keyboard, mouse, and other digital office equipment to draft requirements and map workflows.
* Must be able to frequently communicate, present, and exchange accurate information over video conferencing platforms and in writing with distributed team members.
* Must be able to have close visual acuity to perform activities such as analyzing data, viewing a computer terminal, and extensive reading or documentation review.

**Perks \& Benefits:**

* Health, dental, and vision insurance
* HSA \& FSA
* 401(k) \+ match
* Paid time off \& tuition reimbursement
* Professional development opportunities
* Flexible remote work schedule
  

**The pay range for this role is:**  

85,000 \- 110,000 USD per year(Remote)

jobs.title: Claims Support Supervisor - Auto Insurance
jobs.description:
**COMPANY OVERVIEW:**  

  

Founded in 1989, United Automobile Insurance Company is an innovative and established organization looking for a Claims Support Supervisor to join our team. Family\-owned, UAIC, is one of the largest privately held property and casualty insurance companies in the United States. The key to our growth and success is a commitment to providing quality service to our agents and customers, by providing disciplined underwriting, and strategic claims handling. Our ongoing efforts to invest substantial resources in personnel and technology are the foundation of our promise of assuring maximum efficiency and specialized operations in the industry. We are proud that our independent agents and customers have recognized our dedication by making UAIC the market leader in every state where we conduct business.  

  

***This postion offers remote work in the South East Region***  

  

**SCOPE**  

  

The Claims Support Supervisor leads licensed adjusters who provide elevated claim service, explain coverage and liability information, process first\-party claim payments, and make decisions that move insured losses toward closure. The supervisor provides operational direction, quality oversight, coaching, and escalation support while ensuring work remains within team authority. Matters requiring upper\-level investigation, complex coverage determinations, negotiation, or settlement with claimants are referred to the appropriate adjusting staff.  

  

**KEY DUTIES*** Lead, coach, and support a team of licensed fast track adjusters serving as elevated points of contact for policyholders and claimants.
* Oversee accurate processing of first payments to insureds, shops, and related parties, as well as reissuance of payments previously issued on a claim.
* Review, Approve, and guide team explanations of coverage, policy terms, claim status, liability, and next steps to ensure accuracy, consistency, and appropriate licensed\-level service.
* Review and approve payments, and letters to parties to ensure accuracy and compliance.
* Handle supervisor escalation calls and activities as needed.
* Review and approve fault ratings and coverage resolutions as needed.
* Provide oversight of coverage and liability reviews on insured losses and ensure decisions are supported by claim data, properly documented, and within assigned authority.
* Handle escalated questions and disputes beyond adjuster authority; determine when a matter requires management involvement or referral to an upper\-level adjuster.
* Audit calls, claim notes, payment activity, and decision quality for compliance with company policy, Florida DFS regulations, and documentation standards.
* Monitor productivity, quality, attendance, customer service, payment accuracy, and claim\-resolution metrics; communicate expectations and manage performance concerns.
* Conduct regular one\-on\-ones, coaching, training, and development activities; ensure licenses remain active and required training is completed on time.
* Manage daily staffing, workload, call coverage, and priorities so the team responds effectively to customer needs and moves eligible claims toward closure.
* Serve as a licensed resource for the team and entry\-level CSRs; identify trends, process gaps, and training needs and recommend operational improvements.

  

**QUALIFICATIONS**  

* High school diploma or equivalent; associate degree preferred.
* Active Florida 6\-20 All\-Lines Adjuster license in good standing is required.
* Prior P\&C insurance service or claims experience is required; UAIC experience and previous leadership or coaching experience are preferred.
* Strong communication, organization, analysis, coaching, and conflict\-resolution skills with sound independent judgment.
* Bilingual English/Spanish preferred; proficiency with claim systems, contact\-center tools, reporting, and Microsoft Office applications.

  

**BENEFITS:*** 401(k) Retirement Savings Plan with employer match.
* Comprehensive Medical, Prescription Drug, Vision, and Dental Insurance
* Paid Time Off, Holidays, and Leave programs.
* Flexible spending accounts
* Basic Life Insurance and Voluntary Life/ADD
* Short Term and Long\-Term Disability
