new_jobs.title: Senior Project Manager - Aviation
new_jobs.description:
### **Description**

  

The Senior Project Manager – Aviation leads the successful delivery of airport construction projects — terminal buildings, concourses, and ancillary facilities — through leadership of project teams, client relationships, operational execution, and business performance. This role provides leadership from preconstruction through closeout while mentoring project teams and supporting initiatives that strengthen project delivery across the aviation sector.  

We're looking for someone with real experience building inside an active airport environment — the unique access, security, phasing, and stakeholder coordination that terminal and ancillary building work requires. Experience at any commercial airport is a strong fit; this isn't tied to one specific facility.  

The role reports to the Project Director, Project Executive, Vice President of Operations, or other assigned supervisor, and works closely with clients, consultants, trade partners, field leadership, project teams, and company leadership throughout the project lifecycle.  

### **Key Responsibilities**

  

* Champion project safety, quality, scheduling, and risk management across assigned aviation projects, partnering with field leadership on expectations.
* Maintain accountability for project forecasting, budgeting, billing, cash flow, and overall financial performance.
* Lead administration of prime contracts, subcontracts, purchase orders, and project agreements, directing compliance and change management processes.
* Evaluate cost impacts, forecast variances, and contractual risks; implement corrective actions and support the resolution of claims or disputes.
* Lead, mentor, and develop Project Managers, Assistant Project Managers, Project Engineers, and other project team members.
* Build and maintain long\-term relationships with airport authorities, consultants, subcontractors, and industry partners, serving as a trusted senior advisor.
* Lead project delivery from preconstruction through closeout — planning, constructability, logistics, procurement, staffing, and execution strategy — with particular attention to the phasing and access constraints of an active airport environment.
* Champion integration of VDC/BIM processes to support constructability, coordination, and risk mitigation.
* Oversee turnover, commissioning, and closeout activities through successful project completion.

### **Skills, Knowledge and Expertise**

  

* 12\+ years of progressively responsible construction industry experience, including terminal or ancillary building work at a commercial airport.
* Bachelor's degree in Construction Management, Engineering, Architecture, or a related field, or equivalent combination of education and experience.
* Demonstrated success managing large or complex construction projects and project teams in active, occupied, or security\-controlled environments.
* Expert understanding of construction contracts, project controls, scheduling, procurement, cost management, and risk management.
* Familiarity with airport authority processes, badging/security requirements, and phased construction in operational facilities.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office and construction management platforms such as Procore, CMiC, and/or Navisworks.
* Strong leadership, negotiation, and relationship\-management skills, with the ability to build trust across clients, teams, and company leadership.
* OSHA 30\-Hour certification, or ability to obtain within established company timelines.

### **Benefits**

  

* A rare opportunity to lead aviation\-sector work — terminal and ancillary building construction is a specialized niche with real demand and limited competition for talent.
* Real leadership of large, complex projects — shaping delivery strategy from preconstruction through closeout, not just executing someone else's plan.
* 100% employee\-owned (ESOP) company with a track record dating back to 1925 — your work has a direct stake in the outcome.
* Full benefits package: competitive pay, bonus program, medical/dental/vision insurance, PTO/sick leave, life insurance, 401(k) with match, and a student debt assistance program

### **About W.E. O'Neil Construction**


Building Great Relationships since 1925! 100% employee\-owned general contractor. We build nationally, with locations in AZ, CA, CO, IL, TN, and TX.  

  

W.E. O'Neil Construction has seen steady growth since its founding in 1925 in Chicago by the O'Neil family. Now 100% employee\-owned (ESOP), we embrace people as our number one asset.  

  

Our award\-winning teams are recognized as industry leaders. Our longevity can be attributed to our excellent staff of professionals, our integrity, our commitment to customer satisfaction, and our ability to embrace technology. Our combination of the financial strength of a large national contractor and the responsiveness of a small company brings the best of both worlds to our clients.  

  

Our experience covers virtually every commercial market sector using a broad range of project delivery methods including design\-build, design assist, construction management at risk and lump sum bid.

The Youth Ministry Project Coordinator for parishes provides leadership for the implementation of the Salesian Design–Serve–Reflect Initiative across the nine Salesian parishes of the USA West Province. As a Sales \& Account Manager, you will primarily support the Company's sales and business development efforts, with secondary responsibility for account coordination and operational support. This is a hybrid role focused primarily on identifying and closing new commercial cleaning accounts, developing client relationships, and supporting the transition of new accounts into operations. * Prospect for potential commercial customers through calls, emails, networking, referrals, and other approved methods.
* Research and identify potential customers and decision\-makers.
* Schedule and participate in prospect meetings, client meetings, and property walkthroughs.
* Understand prospective customers' cleaning needs and coordinate appropriate service proposals.
* Prepare and present proposals and service quotations in accordance with Company pricing and approval requirements.
* Follow up with prospective customers throughout the sales process.
* Maintain an organized and up\-to\-date sales pipeline.
* Coordinate the sales process from initial prospect contact through contract execution.
* Develop and maintain professional relationships with prospective and existing customers.
* Work toward established Company sales goals and new\-account targets.
* Maintain accurate records of prospects, proposals, customer communications, and sales activities.

**Account \& Operations Support (30%)**

* Assist with onboarding new commercial cleaning accounts.

new_jobs.title: Sr. E-commerce Account Manager
new_jobs.description:
Verenigde Staten
San Francisco
As Sr. E\-commerce Account Manager, you are responsible for the day\-to\-day management and growth of our U.S. E\-commerce business, encompassing Amazon, Walmart, and other retail platforms. You will achieve commercial goals by ensuring content optimization, excellent campaign execution, and sales\-driving activities that are fully aligned with our brand strategy and customer needs. Reporting to the Head of Sales Natural Foods, you are a key member of the U.S. Sales Team, collaborating closely with marketing, category, and global eCommerce colleagues to accelerate our digital growth. Taking full ownership of Paid Search, DSP, Digital Shelf management, pricing, and portal operations, the Account Manager will ensure strategies are tailored to each platform, executed with precision, and aligned with Lotus’s overall business objectives. This role combines strategic and operational responsibilities to optimize the company’s digital presence, enhance brand visibility, and drive revenue growth. You will own platform health, oversee retail media planning, and translate insights into actionable strategies that drive revenue, expand distribution, and increase market share.
  
### **Functiebeschrijving**


Daily Operations \& Platform Management:
* Lead daily e\-commerce operations across Amazon, Walmart, Instacart, Target, Thrive, Safeway, and Kroger platforms.
* Conduct content and PDP audits, and manage Brand Store updates.
* Maintain scorecards, and pacing tools (including MTD pacing, weekly order review, forecast, and finance check\-ins).

Commercial Planning \& Financial Management:
* Collaborate on promotional planning and ensure strong execution
* Support trade spend tracking, true\-ups, and TPM checkbook analysis.
* Own account forecasting and operational troubleshooting in close partnership with the supply chain team

Paid Media \& Advertising:
* Partner with internal teams and external agencies (e.g., Tinuiti, Amazon, Walmart, Instacart, Costco, Target) to plan, launch, and optimize paid search, DSP, and retail media campaigns.
* Manage media planning and strategy (annual/monthly plans, ROAS targets, budget splits, ecommerce scorecard).
* Execute campaign setup and launch across platforms.
* Perform optimization and bid management (keyword targeting, budget reallocation, ACoS goals).
* Leverage Amazon Marketing Cloud for insights and advanced targeting (audience testing).
* Conduct search terms analysis for trends and insights applicable to paid search strategy.
* Review Amazon AMS spend pacing and adjust strategy as needed.
* Perform paid search campaign optimization for Amazon, Walmart, Instacart, Costco, Thrive, and Target.
* Review DSP ads and conduct pulse checks.

Reporting, Insights \& Communication:
* Prepare and deliver weekly, monthly, and global business recaps.
* Provide detailed performance insights, visualizations, and actionable recommendations.
* Conduct competitive benchmarking (SOV, media trends, category performance).
* Communicate campaign impact and partner with internal teams and stakeholders.
* Refresh monthly Amazon Ads and Walmart Ads performance recaps for global connects.

Strategy \& Innovation:
* Pilot new retail media formats and explore beta features.
* Develop audience strategies using 1P/retailer data.
* Support A/B testing (creative tests, placements tests, dayparting).
* Analyze search term reports, category trends, and competitor activity to identify growth opportunities and inform content, pricing, and media strategies.

Cross\-Functional Collaboration \& Relationships:
* Coordinate with brand (global/local), insights, and category teams for media plan alignment.
* Work cross\-functionally with marketing and creative to request content updates for key seasons, new item launches, and ad hoc as needed.
* Build strong relationships with platform partners ensuring deliverables and opportunities are leveraged.
### **Profiel**


* Proven experience (4\-6 years) in e\-commerce account management, with a track record of managing multiple accounts and platforms ideally within CPG
* Expertise in e\-commerce platforms such as Amazon, Walmart, and Costco, with advanced knowledge of Paid Search, DSP, Digital Shelf management, penalties, and pricing.
* Strong analytical skills to assess campaign performance and make data\-driven decisions.
* Demonstrated success in managing cross\-platform advertising budgets and optimizing campaigns for performance.
* Excellent analytical skills with the ability to interpret data and translate insights into actionable strategies.
* Proficiency in Excel or similar tools for reporting and data analysis.
* Proven ability to optimize product listings and manage compliance responsibilities on Amazon.

  
### **Aanbod**


To be determined.

new_jobs.title: Patient Care Coordinator
new_jobs.description:
**Patient Care Coordinator** **Berkeley Hearing Center \- Berkeley, CA** **Full\-time, In\-Person**

**About Berkeley Hearing Center**

Berkeley Hearing Center has been the audiologist\-led home for premium hearing healthcare in the East Bay for more than seven decades. We don't dispense hearing aids. We build long\-term clinical relationships, guided by our Berkeley Hearing Method (Understand, Build, Adapt, Protect), and powered by a team that genuinely believes care should never be compromised.

This is a practice built on depth, not volume. Our patients are educated, discerning, and often navigating one of the more significant health decisions of their lives. They deserve a front\-line experience that honors that.

**The Role**

We are looking for a Patient Care Coordinator to join a well\-staffed, well\-supported front\-office team. This is a full clinical\-support role, not a reception position. You will be the first voice a new patient hears, the last person they interact with after an appointment, and a consistent presence in a care relationship that may span years.

While it may feel like a routine appointment to our schedule, it is a significant moment for the person walking through the door. Your job is to make sure they feel that difference every single time.

**Who You Are**

Experience matters. But character matters more. If your friends and coworkers would describe you like this, we want to meet you:

* Always warm, positive, and genuinely enjoyable to be around
* Friendly and approachable from the very first hello, including over the phone
* Patient, calm, and compassionate, especially with older adults
* A team player who pitches in without being asked and puts the team before ego
* Detailled and acurate: you double\-check your work and rarely make mistakes
* Takes ownership: gives credit, takes initiative and responsibility, and solves problems
* Comfortable multi\-tasking and confident under pressure
* Coachable and open to feedback, always looking to improve
* Reliable and consistent: here, on time, and prepared

That's not just who we're looking for. It's also who you'll be working alongside.

**Core Responsibilities**

* Answer inbound calls and schedule appointments with empathy and clinical awareness, guiding patients through a process that can feel unfamiliar or daunting
* Manage provider schedules to balance new\-patient access with continuity of care for returning patients
* Prepare audiologists for appointments with complete, accurate notes and relevant patient history
* Welcome patients in a way that reflects the quality of care they are about to receive
* Coordinate hearing technology orders, repairs, and manufacturer communications
* Handle patient check\-out, payment collection, and financial policy communication with clarity and confidence

**What We're Looking For**

* Strong interpersonal skills, particularly with older adults and their families
* Detail\-oriented with a genuine understanding of HIPAA and patient confidentiality
* Technologically confident: VoIP phones, online scheduling, digital fax queues, and a willingness to learn new systems
* A clear, confident communicator in writing and in person
* Someone who helps patients understand the value of treatment through honest, educational conversation
* Spanish fluency is a meaningful advantage in our patient community
* Healthcare or audiology front\-office experience is a plus, but we hire for the person first

**What You Get**

* $25\-28/hour base pay
* Health and dental coverage after 60 days
* Team\-based bonus opportunities tied to practice performance
* Profit\-sharing 401(k) after one year
* Real growth potential as the practice expands
* A team that is genuinely glad you're here

**How to Apply**

Send us your resume and a brief note explaining why this role is the right fit for you.

One more thing: this posting contains exactly two spelling errors. Point them out. It tells us something important about how you work.

We look forward to meeting you.

Job Type: Full\-time

Pay: $25\.00 \- $28\.00 per hour

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* Dental insurance
* Health insurance
* Opportunities for advancement
* Paid sick time
* Paid time off
* Profit sharing

Work Location: In person

new_jobs.title: Lead Care Manager
new_jobs.description:
ABOUT US
Homebridge serves a high risk, high needs, complex\-diagnosed population with a combination of domestic, personal, and paramedical homecare functions funded through IHSS. Our work allows an often\-underserved population to live safely in their community. Homebridge offers a dynamic, fast\-paced work environment with 350\+ unionized field workers and 90\+ internal office staff.  

POSITION SUMMARY
The Lead Care Manager oversees the delivery of Enhanced Care Management services for Medi‑Cal members with complex medical, behavioral, and social needs. This role provides clinical oversight, supports care managers, ensures fidelity to CalAIM ECM requirements, and maintains high‑quality, person‑centered care coordination across medical, behavioral health, community, and social service systems.  

ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS* Conduct comprehensive assessments of clients' health, social, and environmental needs to develop personalized care plans.
* Support clients in engaging in the Enhanced Care Management seven core services, including outreach and engagement, comprehensive assessment/care management planning, enhanced care coordination, health promotion, comprehensive transitional care, individual and family supports, and referrals to community/social supports.
* Coordinate with healthcare providers, social services, and other community resources to ensure clients receive holistic and continuous care.
* Regularly monitor clients' progress, adjusting care plans as necessary, and conduct follow\-up visits or calls to ensure they are adhering to their care plans.
* Advocate on behalf of clients to secure necessary services and support, ensuring their needs and preferences are met.
* Maintain accurate and timely documentation of client interactions, care plans, and progress reports, ensuring compliance with organizational and regulatory standards.
* Educate clients and their families about their health conditions, treatment options, and available resources to empower them to make informed decisions.
* Work collaboratively with multidisciplinary teams to ensure integrated and coordinated care, participating in case conferences and team meetings as needed.
  

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, AND ABILITIES* Ability to understand and use computer applications, including spreadsheets and electronic health records; including internet access and email.
* Ability to understand the needs of clients from different cultures and socioeconomic backgrounds.
* Awareness of community resources and services.
* Effective organizational and time management skills.
* Ability to solve problems and be proactive.
* Ability to communicate effectively and professionally with coworkers, clients and members of the community.
* Ability to travel within the service area.
  

EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE* Two (2\) years of experience in Mental Health or community services; or Bachelor's degree in Social Services or related field.
* Experience working in case or care management, preferably with a background in healthcare or social services.
  

WORK ENVIRONMENT
This position will have in the field and office work environments which includes frequent travel \- must be able to travel on foot or via public transportation to all parts of San Francisco County for performance of job duties. May occasionally be exposed to outside weather conditions while traveling to clients. Some exposure to physical risk. Exposure to client apartments, rooms, homes and other venues so that services can be provided, client homes may have pets/pet dander and/or cigarette smoke. May include contact with clients with mental health and/or personal hygiene issues.  

PHYSICAL DEMANDS
The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individual with disabilities to perform the essential functions. While performing the duties of the job, the employee is regularly required to talk or hear. The employee is frequently required to sit for extended periods of time at a desk or computer workstation. The employee is frequently required to stand, walk, sit, use hands to finger, handle, or feel, reach with hands and arms. The employee is occasionally required to climb or balance and stoop, kneel, or crouch. The employee may occasionally lift and/or move up to 15 pounds. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, color vision, and ability to adjust focus. *Homebridge Is an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran or disability status.*

new_jobs.description:
**ASE MANAGER II**

**Location: Coronado Hotel**

**Hourly Wage: $30\.44 Status: Non\-exempt, Hourly**

**Benefited After 1 month intro period**

 **Community Forward SF** is a collection of vital programs that ensures our neighbors experiencing homelessness have effective services designed for their unique needs. Whether one needs housing, medical shelter, a safe place to become sober, or calm in the face of domestic violence \- we care for those most vulnerable in our community.

  

We are not just one program. We are a network of programs designed to work together to meet every stage of need. We focus on the hardest to reach, most vulnerable people: Women \& Trans Women, Medical Crisis, Substance Use Disorder, and Older Adults. Our programs meet the needs of people, rather than demanding that people meet the needs of our programs.

 **JOB SUMMARY:**


Community Forward SF is hiring a Case Manager for our permanent supportive housing site, The Coronado. * Other duties as assigned.

**Job Description**

***A bit about this role***


This specific role provides Social Work support to our Palliative Care Program.


Devoted’s virtual Palliative Care program serves members with complex needs and life\-limiting illness who otherwise would not have access to specialized palliative care. We pride ourselves on providing highly compassionate, patient\-centered goals of care counseling and symptom management for members projected to be in the final year of life. We meet patients where they are and support them in defining quality of life, achieving meaningful goals, and transitioning to hospice care.


As a Palliative Care Social Work Case Manager, you will serve our patients as an advocate, coach, and connector \- working closely with patients, caregivers and other members of the team to identify and eliminate socioeconomic and psychosocial barriers and provide supportive counseling. This role will require you to develop individualized care plans that align community, clinical, and patients’ personal resources.You will provide coaching on improving coping skills, self\-management, and caregiver assistance, re\-enforce disease\-specific education and facilitate goals of care and advanced care planning discussions, including hospice care transitions when appropriate.

* Telephonic and video visits with patients and caregivers
* Establish trust and build strong relationships with our patients

	+ Provide emotional and caregiver support
	+ Assist in navigating complex family/support issues

new_jobs.description:
**About Net at Work**

  

Founded in 1996, Net at Work is one of North America’s largest technology advisors and solution providers for small and mid\-size businesses. Our award\-winning consultancy offers a rich portfolio of next\-generation technology, industry expertise, implementation and managed services to help organizations derive value from the transformative benefits of technology.  

  

Through the integration of ERP, HCM and/or CRM solutions, Net at Work offers unique, industry\-specific solutions and operation platforms that enable companies to compete more effectively in today’s digital economy. For more information, visit www.netatwork.com.

 **About this Position**


As Net at Work continues to evolve its internal systems, processes, and technology platforms, we are seeking a Systems Learning Specialist to support employee readiness, technology adoption, and learning enablement across the organization.

  

The Systems Learning Specialist plays a key role in helping employees successfully adopt and utilize business systems, tools, and processes. This role partners closely with Learning \& Development, Systems Operations, and business stakeholders to transform system requirements, workflows, and process updates into engaging and effective learning experiences.

  

This position is focused on the execution of training initiatives, including content development, facilitation, documentation, and user adoption support across multiple technology platforms.

 **Job Responsibilities**

* Develop and deliver instructor\-led, virtual, and self\-paced training programs for employees.
* Create engaging learning materials including presentations, job aids, quick reference guides, videos, process documentation, and knowledge articles.
* Support employee adoption of business systems including ticketing platforms, HR systems, collaboration tools, and operational applications.
* Translate system updates, process changes, and business requirements into clear learning content.
* Conduct platform walkthroughs, testing, and hands\-on exploration to understand workflows and user experiences before developing training materials.
* Facilitate new system launches, enhancements, and adoption initiatives.
* Assist with AI enablement efforts by developing and delivering foundational AI learning content and best practices.
* Maintain and update training materials to ensure content remains accurate and current.
* Partner with subject matter experts to gather information and validate training effectiveness.
* Support employee onboarding and ongoing learning initiatives related to business systems and technology tools.
* Track participation, feedback, and adoption metrics to continuously improve learning programs.

 **Job Requirements**

* 2\-5 years of experience in corporate training, learning and development, employee enablement, instructional design, or systems training.
* Experience creating training content and learning materials.
* Strong presentation and facilitation skills.
* Ability to quickly learn new software platforms and business processes.
* Excellent written communication and documentation skills.
* Strong organizational and project coordination abilities.
* Proficiency with Microsoft 365 applications including PowerPoint, Teams, Excel, Word, and SharePoint.
* Experience supporting software implementations or system rollouts.
* Experience with ticketing systems, CRM platforms, HRIS platforms, or workflow applications.
* Familiarity with learning management systems and digital learning tools.
* Experience creating video\-based learning content or microlearning assets.
* Exposure to AI tools and AI\-assisted content development.

 **Customer Requirements**


This job may require access to customer information, systems, and/or premises. As a result, this job may require customer approval for such access as an essential job function.

 **Core Competencies**

* **Client Champion** – Relentlessly exceed client expectations. Consistently anticipate needs to deliver valuable solutions and extraordinary outcomes.
* **Problem Solver** – Smart, analytical, inquisitive, knowledge\-seeker that thrives on a challenge.
* **Promise Keeper** – Place high value on keeping our word and doing the right thing. Demonstrate honesty, integrity, and commitment.
* **Collaborative Integrator** –Team player, unifier, relationship\-oriented, win\-win seeker, exemplify the concept of relationships through trust and unity.
* **Driven Intrapreneur** – Exceed goals using independent creative thinking, optimism, self\-confidence, and a can\-do attitude.
* **Inspiring Coach** – Help employees, clients and partners using knowledge, expertise, experience, and situational fluency.

 **Compensation and Benefits**


Base salary range: $85,000 to $95,000\.


This position is also eligible for a bonus in accordance with the terms of the Company's plan.

new_jobs.description:
**Why** **You’ll** **Love Working Here**



At SimuTech Group, we are driving innovation and changing the world through the power of engineering simulation. Our growing team of energetic, tech\-savvy professionals works hard every day to inspire our clients to push the boundaries of innovation and deliver transformational products. If you are motivated and driven by a culture where top\-notch work ethic and passion are rewarded, then a career with SimuTech Group may be for you!



**The Benefits of Being Part of Our Team**



* Unmatched Health Coverage: Zero\-cost in\-network medical care with no premiums, deductibles, or copays for you and your family.


* Complete Dental \& Vision Benefits: 100% premium coverage for dental and vision insurance.


* Wellness Programs Tailored to You: Access free workouts, personalized training sessions, nutritional counseling, mindfulness programs, stress management, and more with our corporate wellness coach.
  


**What Makes This Role Great?**



* You’ll thrive in a competitive and results\-driven environment where your leadership, sales expertise, and ability to build relationships are celebrated.


* You’ll have the opportunity to drive revenue growth by connecting with decision\-makers and delivering impactful solutions to meet client needs.


* You’ll join a dynamic sales team that values ambition, creativity, and a passion for achieving goals.
  


**What** **You’ll** **Do**



As a Services Territory Account Manager, you will sell SimuTech consulting services directly to end users via phone, virtual, and face\-to\-face contact. You’ll manage both transactional and complex sales while collaborating closely with a dynamic team of highly skilled engineers who provide technical expertise throughout the sales cycle.



Lead Business Development



* Identify and connect with potential clients, leveraging persuasive communication skills to introduce SimuTech’s consulting solutions.


* Challenge clients by proposing innovative tools and engineering processes, establishing yourself as a trusted advisor.


* Collaborate with inside sales, marketing, and engineering teams to develop customized solutions for client challenges.


Drive Sales Growth

Execute structured, milestone\-driven sales strategies to meet or exceed ambitious revenue goals.



* Manage consultative sales processes, engaging with decision\-makers at all levels to uncover needs and deliver tailored solutions.


* Negotiate and structure consulting deals to drive Ansys software sales and deliver measurable client value.


Build Strong Relationships



* Develop and nurture long\-term partnerships with clients, ensuring ongoing satisfaction and success.


* Organize and lead impactful customer\-facing events, such as workshops, user groups, and industry seminars.


* Represent SimuTech Group at industry events, positioning yourself as an industry expert and thought leader.
  


**What** **You’ll** **Bring**



Education \& Experience



* Bachelor’s degree or a minimum of 5 years of industry experience.


* Previous technical sales or engineering experience.


**Skills**



* Confidence and Independence: You’re a self\-starter who takes initiative and thrives in situations where you can think on your feet.


* Persuasive Communication: You excel at delivering compelling messages and can adapt your style to different audiences.


* Analytical Thinking: You dig deeper to uncover customer needs, crafting solutions that resonate with their challenges.


* Resilience: You handle rejection effectively, maintaining a positive outlook and determination to succeed.


* Technical Expertise: A solid understanding of engineering processes and related technologies (CAD, 3D printing, HPC).


* Time Management: You prioritize effectively and stay organized, even in a fast\-paced, high\-pressure environment.
  


**Additional Benefits**



* Short Term Disability


* Long Term Disability


* 401k Plan with employer match


* Limited Flexible Spending Account


* Life Insurance


* Paid time off


* Professional development assistance


* Referral program


* Tuition reimbursement


* Bonus plan

*(Compensation may vary outside of this range depending on* *a number of* *factors, including a candidate's qualifications, skills, competencies, experience, and location.)*



Location: Remote\-based in California

  


**Take the Next Step**



This is your opportunity to join a forward\-thinking team where your skills, creativity, and ambition will be celebrated. Apply today to become a key player in SimuTech Group’s mission to revolutionize the engineering industry.

**Job Summary**

We are seeking a dynamic and proactive Operations Manager to lead our retail operations with energy and precision. In this pivotal role, you will oversee daily store functions, manage teams, and ensure seamless execution of sales, inventory control, customer service, and administrative tasks. Your leadership will drive operational excellence, foster a positive team environment, and contribute to the overall success of our retail business. This position offers an exciting opportunity for a motivated individual to make a significant impact by implementing efficient processes and inspiring high performance across all store activities.

**Duties**

* Lead and supervise retail staff, including assistant managers and sales teams, to ensure excellent customer service and operational efficiency
* Oversee inventory management, stock replenishment, merchandising, and product placement to maximize sales potential
* Manage purchasing, pricing strategies, and POS (Point of Sale) systems to optimize sales transactions and cash handling procedures
* Coordinate employee orientation, training \& development programs, and performance evaluations to build a skilled and motivated team
* Handle payroll processing, bookkeeping, budgeting, and financial record\-keeping with accuracy and attention to detail
* Implement marketing initiatives and promotional activities to attract customers and boost sales in the store
* Ensure compliance with safety standards, store policies, and operational procedures while supervising shift management and cash handling

**Requirements**

* Proven management experience in retail or related industries with supervisory responsibilities in sales teams or store operations
* Strong skills in negotiation, recruiting, interviewing, employee orientation, and training \& development
* Multilingual or bilingual abilities are highly desirable for effective communication with diverse customer bases
* Familiarity with POS systems, inventory control tools, merchandising techniques, and retail math principles
* Excellent communication skills—both managerial and interpersonal—with the ability to motivate teams and foster collaboration
* Demonstrated organizational skills with the ability to handle multiple priorities such as budgeting, scheduling, stock management, and customer service simultaneously
* Experience in grocery stores or wireless sales environments is a plus but not required; a background in retail management is essential
* Basic math proficiency for cash handling, pricing adjustments, sales calculations, and inventory tracking
* Knowledge of phone etiquette, customer service best practices, and store product knowledge is important for success in this role

Join us as an Operations Manager if you’re passionate about leading teams to deliver outstanding retail experiences! new_jobs.description:
We are hiring a **Mandarin\-speaking Immigration Case Manager — AI Operations** who combines strong U.S. immigration case\-management experience with advanced AI and legal\-technology skills.

This is not a traditional paralegal position.

We are building an AI\-native immigration practice where highly capable case managers use AI and modern case\-management technology to independently manage substantially more of the case lifecycle—from intake and evidence collection through drafting, quality control, and attorney\-ready review.

You do **not** need to be an AI engineer or programmer.

You **do need to be highly fluent with AI and modern business software and already know how to use Claude effectively for sophisticated immigration work.**

We are specifically looking for someone who understands how to use Claude beyond basic prompting—for example, working with large case files and long\-context documents, structuring complex immigration analysis, extracting and organizing evidence, identifying inconsistencies and missing information, developing evidence matrices, preparing and improving drafts, analyzing RFEs, performing quality control, and building repeatable AI\-assisted workflows.

You should know how to give AI the right context and instructions, evaluate its output critically, verify it against source documents, identify hallucinations or unsupported conclusions, and iterate until the work product meets a professional standard.

**AI proficiency is a core qualification for this position, not something we expect to teach from the beginning.**

**What You’ll Do**

You will take ownership of immigration cases from assignment through attorney review, including:

* Communicating directly with clients in Mandarin and English
* Reviewing intake information, CVs, immigration records, and supporting documents
* Identifying missing information and proactively following up
* Managing case progress, deadlines, and outstanding items
* Preparing immigration forms and supporting documentation
* Organizing evidence and exhibits
* Assisting with petitions, recommendation letters, RFEs, and other case materials
* Using Claude extensively for document analysis, evidence analysis, drafting, case organization, and quality control
* Using modern case\-management and business software efficiently
* Checking AI\-generated work against the underlying record
* Identifying factual inconsistencies and potential issues
* Escalating matters requiring attorney judgment
* Developing better prompts, templates, checklists, and repeatable workflows
* Delivering organized, substantially complete cases for attorney review

The objective is straightforward:

**Once a case is assigned to you, you should be capable of moving it from intake to attorney\-ready review with minimal attorney intervention.**

**Who We’re Looking For**

You may be a strong fit if you have:

* Professional fluency in **Mandarin Chinese and English**
* Meaningful U.S. immigration case\-management or paralegal experience
* **Advanced proficiency using Claude for professional immigration work**
* Strong general AI literacy and the ability to work effectively with large amounts of information
* High proficiency with modern corporate software, document\-management systems, cloud collaboration tools, and case\-management platforms
* Experience independently managing immigration cases
* Excellent organization and attention to factual detail
* Strong written communication skills
* The ability to manage multiple matters without constant attorney supervision
* The judgment to distinguish routine production issues from matters requiring attorney attention

Experience with employment\-based immigration—including **EB\-1A, EB\-2 NIW, O\-1, H\-1B, L\-1, PERM, I\-140, and I\-485**—is highly valued.

Experience at a sophisticated business immigration practice is a plus, but not required.

**What “AI Proficiency” Means to Us**

We are **not** looking for someone whose AI experience consists primarily of asking ChatGPT or Claude to rewrite emails.

A strong candidate should be comfortable demonstrating how they use Claude to work through an actual immigration matter.

For example, you should be able to take a substantial client file and use AI intelligently to:

* understand and structure the case;
* extract relevant facts from multiple documents;
* identify missing or contradictory information;
* create timelines;
* analyze and categorize evidence;
* build evidence matrices;
* analyze publications and citation records;
* organize EB\-1A/O\-1 evidence by criterion;
* organize NIW evidence around the proposed endeavor;
* analyze an RFE against the existing record;
* prepare customized evidence requests;
* produce first drafts from verified source materials;
* compare drafts against underlying evidence;
* perform consistency and quality\-control reviews;
* and turn successful approaches into reusable workflows.

You should also understand AI’s limitations.

**Fast AI\-generated work that contains unsupported facts, missed evidence, or hallucinations is not good work.**

The person we want knows how to make AI powerful **and** reliable.

**Why This Role Is Different**

Most immigration case\-management positions are still structured around traditional production methods.

This one is not.

We want to see what happens when an experienced immigration professional becomes exceptionally effective at combining:

**Immigration knowledge \+ case ownership \+ Claude \+ modern software \+ operational judgment.**

The objective is not simply to draft faster. It is to enable one excellent case manager to perform work that traditionally required substantially more administrative and junior\-production support.

**Career Growth**

This position has a significant growth path for someone who performs exceptionally well:

**Immigration Case Manager — AI Operations**  
→ **Senior Immigration Case Manager — AI Operations**  
→ **AI Operations / Case Management Lead**  
→ **Manager o

new_jobs.title: Sales and Marketing Operations Manager
new_jobs.description:
DMA Engineering is looking for a resourceful and organized Sales and Marketing Operations Manager to join our team. You will have the opportunity to take ownership of your work, bring ideas to life, and see your execution directly shape how a growing firm wins new business. We value curiosity, ownership, and a mindset focused on continuous learning and improvement.

We are seeking someone who is self\-sufficient, resourceful, and confident in making decisions. You will manage priorities, keep the sales pipeline moving, and direct specialized contributors while still writing, editing, and delivering the work yourself. If you are ready to take the next step in your career and help shape how our firm grows, we would love to hear from you.

**Role Description**

This is a part\-time, remote Sales and Marketing Operations Manager role, open to candidates anywhere in the USA, with candidates based in Colorado a plus. This role runs the business development engine of the company and is ideal for someone who wants to take ownership and make a real impact.

* Own execution of DMA's sales and marketing strategy, translating leadership priorities into a consistent cadence of outreach, content, and follow through
* Prepare and assemble proposals in PandaDoc, coordinating with the principal and engineering team on scope and pricing
* Draft outreach to potential partners, relationship building contacts, and targeted geographic lists
* Manage the sales inbox and maintain HubSpot, including sales workflows, automations, sequences, and SOPs
* Write and edit marketing content, including the Trend newsletter, the luxury residential newsletter, and LinkedIn posts
* Manage video content editors and the professionals supporting advertising, SEO, and GEO efforts

**Minimum Requirements**

* Prior experience in a sales support, marketing, business development, or coordination role
* Strong written communication skills and comfort drafting emails and marketing content for clients and partners
* Experience with a CRM platform (HubSpot preferred) or a demonstrated ability to learn one quickly
* Comfortable working independently and remotely, owning a task list and priorities with minimal oversight
* Please see complete position description for other important skills and competencies

**Company Description**

DMA Engineering is a Colorado\-based eMEP engineering firm, recognized for its expertise in sustainable eMEP solutions and energy\-efficient design. Through integrated design, commissioning, and building automation, we create efficient, resilient systems for luxury residential, commercial, community and government projects.

Committed to environmental stewardship, we focus on creating sustainable energy solutions and design, including ground and air source heat pumps, radiant systems, indoor air quality solutions, energy modeling, and Net Zero design and consulting. Explore our diverse portfolio at dma\-eng.com/projects.

**Compensation and Benefits**

* Approximately 20 to 30 hours per week, with flexibility on schedule
* Fully remote
* Paid holidays
* Paid sick leave in accordance with state law

We are an equal opportunity employer and welcome candidates from all backgrounds.

**How to Apply**

Please send your cover letter and resume to **hireme@dma\-eng.com**

Pay: $54,500\.00 \- $62,500\.00 per year

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule
* Paid time off
* Professional development assistance

Work Location: Remote

new_jobs.title: Sales Operations Manager

Compensation: $75,000 \- $100,000 annual salary, plus annual bonus and merit increases contingent upon company performance


Employment Type: Full\-Time, Salaried, Exempt


Reports to: Chief Growth Officer


Location: US; fully remote with some travel


Schedule: Primarily standard business hours with flexibility to work with colleagues and partners across US time zones


**Who We Are**
--------------


Renalogic is dedicated to helping our clients manage the human and financial costs of chronic kidney disease. To help us in our mission, we hire people who are humble, hungry, and smart. And it sure helps if you have a sense of humor. We're not perfect, but we're trying to build a company that we are all proud of. Our 96% client retention suggests we're on the right path.


**Position Overview**
---------------------


The Sales Operations Manager is responsible for the data, processes, reporting, and tools that support Renalogic's commercial organization. This person will make our CRM a reliable source of information, coordinate the commercial forecasting process, and help teams work consistently from lead generation through sales and implementation.


The role reports to the Chief Growth Officer and works closely with the SVP of Sales. The SVP of Sales leads the sales team, manages pipeline performance, and owns the field\-sales forecast. The Sales Operations Manager provides the structure, analysis, and operational support that enable those activities and support the Chief Growth Officer's accountability for the consolidated commercial forecast.


**How You'll Contribute**
-------------------------


**CRM and data integrity**


* Own the day\-to\-day administration and quality of commercial data in Zoho CRM, including accounts, contacts, leads, opportunities, and account ownership.
* Establish and maintain standards for required fields, opportunity stages, deal updates, account hierarchy, and pipeline hygiene.
* Identify stale, incomplete, or inconsistent records and work with the appropriate team members to resolve them.
* Coordinate with Sales, Marketing, Finance, and client\-facing teams to ensure commercial data is accurate and consistent across handoffs and reporting.

  

**Forecasting, reporting, and analysis**


* Coordinate the commercial forecasting process by collecting inputs, maintaining the underlying data, consolidating results, and reporting changes against prior forecasts and actual performance.
* Provide the SVP of Sales with reliable field\-sales pipeline and forecast reporting, and provide the Chief Growth Officer with the information needed to manage the consolidated commercial forecast.
* Build and maintain dashboards and recurring reports on pipeline health, sales production, conversion, account activity, and other commercial performance measures.
* Analyze results by territory, seller, channel, partner, and product to help leadership identify trends, gaps, and opportunities.
* Support commercial planning and budgeting with accurate data, clear assumptions, and timely reporting.


**Commercial processes and coordination**


* Document, administer, and improve approved sales processes, including lead assignment, opportunity management, proposal and RFP coordination, and sales\-to\-implementation handoffs.
* Partner closely with the SVP of Sales to support consistent execution of sales initiatives, pipeline reviews, and team workflows.
* Maintain records of approved territory, account, lead, and quota assignments. Provide analysis to support leadership decisions about coverage and resource allocation.
* Work with Marketing to track lead sources, campaign results, and the conversion of qualified leads into sales opportunities.
* Coordinate with Finance and HR on sales incentive data, calculations, reporting, and implementation of approved plan changes.
* Partner with IT and other stakeholders to improve sales technology and implement approved changes.
* Ensure commercial policies and procedures are documented, accessible, and kept current.


**What You'll Need to Have**
----------------------------


* B.A./B.S. in a related field or equivalent experience.
* At least five years' experience successfully completing and owning sales operations tasks and responsibilities.
* At least three years' direct experience working within a CRM to create reporting, analyze trends, and design/implement process change.
* Strong Excel skills and proficiency with PowerPoint, Word, and other Microsoft applications.
* Strong analytical skills and the ability to communicate findings clearly to sales leaders and other stakeholders.
* Experience working across departments to improve processes and resolve data issues.
* Strong working knowledge of self\-funded health plans is strongly preferred.
* Zoho CRM experience or certifications strongly preferred.
* Reliable power and secured internet that runs at 11 mbps or more.
* A designated, private area to conduct work with minimal interruptions is required.
* Ability to work independently, manage competing deadlines, and navigate change.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, attention to detail, and sound judgment.
* Ability and willingness to travel multiple times a year, which will include overnight stays for corporate gatherings, conferences, and health fairs.
* Ability to attend and professionally engage in video meetings with other employees and clients.
* Ability to overcome obstacles with a ‘yes if...' approach.
* Ability to effectively balance competing deadlines without losing focus on the bigger picture.


**What We Offer**
-----------------

* Market competitive salary and, plus potential annual merit increases and bonuses contingent on the company's fiscal performance.
* Generous paid time off and paid holidays, because we value recharging.
* A comprehensive health benefits plan with a portion of premiums covered by the company. Benefits include medical, dental, vision, and other benefits which are optional to the empl

Loomis prides itself on providing employees with opportunities for career advancement and job satisfaction. In fact, many of our company’s managers, vice presidents, and corporate executives started out in the branches as driver/guards and tellers. Our work can be challenging, but the thousands who have stayed with our company for decades will tell you that if you have the desire to learn and the drive to succeed, Loomis is the place to be. Come join our team!
  
  

**Job Overview:** This position is responsible for developing Loomis’ SafePoint product and solution configuration and managing onboarding and implementation processes for specified clients’ implementations, reporting to the Implementation Specialist Manager. This role will also manage SafePoint logistics, equipment inventory coordination, vendor ordering, and planning alignment to ensure the right devices, parts, and support materials are available for each implementation timeline.
  
  

**Accountabilities:**  

* Accountable for end\-to\-end implementation, resource scheduling, stakeholder communication, maintaining the implementation process, and ensuring timely, professional installation, implementation, and training of the SafePoint Solution.
* Engage with company and clients in a positive, professional, and proactive manner.
* Study and understand the product offering and all aspects of the solution’s implementation project plan, and become a Subject Matter Expert on SafePoint and all of its applications and permutations.
* Use all existing resources and seek additional avenues to improve your abilities and value to the company and its clients, working on personal development according to the guidelines and expectations set in your employee development plan.
* Actively ensure you meet managers' and clients' expectations, driving continuous improvement, process efficiency, and customer (internal and external) satisfaction.
* Utilize sound Project Management skills and capabilities to deliver a comprehensive and problem\-free solution implementation.
* Utilize critical communication skills and influence management techniques to motivate co\-workers, clients, and end\-user customers for the successful completion of the projects under your control.
* Coordinate SafePoint equipment logistics, including device allocation, shipment timing, delivery tracking, installation readiness, and inventory availability across implementation projects.
* Work closely with Planning, Operations, Vendors, and service partners to forecast upcoming SafePoint deployment needs and align ordering schedules with client implementation dates.
* Support vendor ordering processes by monitoring purchase requests, order status, delivery commitments, backorders, and escalation needs to prevent implementation delays.
* Maintain visibility into SafePoint implementation inventory, including units on hand, units committed to projects, units in transit, and inventory risks requiring management attention.
* Continually evaluate the implementation process, looking for better, faster, more profitable ways to sell, install, and operate the product.
* Establish and maintain exceptional client relationships at a peer level and explore additional ways that Loomis can provide value.
* Actively develop and improve upon client relationship management and engagement skills.
* Vendor management: continue to push vendors to support customers professionally and efficiently.

* Other duties as assigned.


**Primary Requirements:**  

* Bachelor’s Degree or Technical institute degree/certificate in Business, Computer Science, IS, or other related field, preferred.
* Equivalent work experience in lieu of degree.
* Minimum of 5 years of operational process improvement experience required.
* Proven Project management and Quality systems implementation experience is required.
* Must have excellent communication skills.
* Ability to travel up to 10% is required.
* Ability to influence management is required.
* Experience coordinating logistics, inventory tracking, vendor ordering, or supply planning is strongly preferred.
* Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple implementation schedules, equipment requirements, and vendor follow\-ups simultaneously.


Loomis is an Equal Opportunity Employer and Drug Free Workplace. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to their race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, protected veteran status or disability.

new_jobs.description:
**Posting Title:** Assistant Project Manager \- O\&M
**Reports To:** Senior O\&M Specialist**Location:** Hybrid or Remote**Salary Range:** $82,000 to $106,000
* ***This position is eligible for the annual performance bonus plan.***

This position primarily involves working remotely or in an office.

Final determination of a successful candidate’s starting pay will vary based on a number of factors, including market location and may vary depending on job\-related knowledge, skills, education and experience. The pay scale listed for this position is generally for candidates that meet the specified qualifications and requirements listed on this specific job description. We provide a competitive compensation package that recognizes your experience, credentials, and education alongside a robust benefits program to meet your needs. Our compensation reflects the cost of labor across several US geographic markets.**WHO WE ARE**  

Since 1954, Cupertino Electric, Inc. (CEI)has been powered by people who’ve built a reputation for delivering high\-profile, complex projects. Real, tangible things that alter the landscape and improve lives. And we've done it with integrity for more than 70 years. We’re problem solvers and innovation seekers. We’re team players and safety fanatics. And we're proud to be part of Quanta Services (PWR:NYSE), North America's largest employer of skilled craft labor. Because what we do is important, but how we do it is everything.
**THE ENERGY TEAM**
Our Energy Group at CEI builds projects from the field to the grid. Whether it’s a solar, battery storage, substation, EV charging, microgrid or converter station project, our skilled project managers, engineers and field employees deliver when it matters most. We work with customers on programs of all sizes—those spanning several smaller sites or spanning several thousand acres. Besides building some of the nation’s largest utility\-scale solar plants and installing more EV charging stations in California than any other contractor, we are dedicated to running a business that is environmentally responsible.
**ABOUT THE ROLE**
At Cupertino Electric, **Assistant Project Managers (APM)** are key to coordination between the field team, project team, and our customers. By partnering with the Project Manager, the APM will learn the processes and witness the critical thinking required for approaching our projects from a strategic lens. The APM will gain a deep understanding of CEI’s scope of work on a project. Additionally, they contribute to, review, and track project activities including change orders, submittals, tracking logs, and related project documents.
* Lead team meetings and provide guidance to Project Engineers and Project Coordinators in partnership with the Project Manager, Production Manager, field team and Trade Partners.
* Identifies cost and schedule impacts associated with RFIs, submittals, and design changes and provides timely notification.
* Prices change orders consistently and in a timely manner for project manager review and approval.
* Develops and manages close out documents as the Project progresses.
* Coordinate commissioning activities w/ 3rd party. Tracks and follows up on open items.
* Maintain strong working partnerships with vendors and subcontractors. Coordinates accurate material releases on time and consistent with project documents. Track material releases, changes and coordinate delivery with construction schedule.

**ABOUT YOU*** Serve as the go\-to person to help resolve any issues or potential problem areas.
* Actively thinks about new ways to improve or change processes. Brings innovative and entrepreneurial thinking to a project.
* Prior experience working on semi\-remote jobsites, supervising others. Renewables/Large Electrical/Data Center build experience highly desired.
* Good working knowledge of MS applications including Excel.
* Prior experience in electrical estimating and the ability to accurately estimate change order pricing.
* Knowledge of Electrical Code and Civil Construction.

**WHAT YOU WILL GAIN**
As an Assistant Project Manager (APM) at Cupertino Electric, you will be empowered to learn the skills and competencies required to become a successful Project Manager. APMs have the opportunity to execute Project Manager level activities within the safety of the larger Project Team. This is when all of the deep, technical, and process\-guided learning comes into play. Partnered with a Project Manager, through practice and feedback, you will learn the processes, and witness the critical thinking required for strategic project approach, which will in turn set you up for a successful future on your career path. You will be interacting extensively with the CEI Production Team, customers, and vendor and subcontractor partners, giving you opportunities to cultivate relationships and build your professional network.
**MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS***Any combination of education and experience that, in the sole judgment and discretion of Company, would likely provide the required knowledge, skills and abilities as well as possession of any required licenses or certifications may qualify.***Education:** High School Diploma or GED required. Bachelor’s Degree in Construction Management, Business, Engineering, or similar preferred.
**Licensure/Certifications:** None required.
**Experience:** Three (3\) or more years of experience specifically as a Project Engineer in electrical construction (Renewable Energy preferred) or MEP/Civil/Structural experience in general contracting. Minimum five (5\)\+ years of related experience, including some time managing smaller projects.
**Driving Record:** Valid state\-issued driver’s license and satisfactory driving record.
* Applicants must be authorized to work in the United States. This position is not eligible for sponsorship.

**Location:** Remote (U.S.\-based) Preference given to CA, TX, and FL  

**Department:** Customer Success  

**Reports to:** Chief Customer Officer  

**Starting Pay Range: $90k \- $105k/yr**  

  

The Arcadium platform is the premier sales, CRM and vehicle management solution in the heavy\-duty truck market. As part of Work Truck Solutions, Arcadium has a culture that combines strong leadership, collaboration, and fun, with incredible growth opportunities for our employees in a fast\-paced work environment providing employee engagement, recognition, and development. Our software company is committed to innovation in the rapidly changing heavy\-duty vehicle market.  

Our vision and culture allow employees to be recognized as thought leaders and thrive in their careers.

	+ **New Functionality for Existing Customers:** Plan and implement new products, features, and expanded use \- such as additional rooftops, departments, or modules \- for existing customers, partnering with Account Managers and Sales to drive adoption and utilization.
	+ **Cross\-Functional Coordination:** Coordinate the activities of Support, Development, Product, Sales, and Account Management that contribute to each implementation \- scoping requests, tracking deliverables, escalating blockers, and ensuring a clean handoff to Account Management after go\-live.
	+ **Process \& Product Improvement:** Identify recurring issues, bottlenecks, and gaps in the implementation process and recommend process, tooling, and product changes that improve quality, shorten time\-to\-value, and increase efficiency.

	+ **Documentation \& Reporting:** Maintain accurate, real\-time implementation status, configuration records, training completion, and customer feedback within the company CRM system, and contribute to implementation playbooks, templates, and training materials.

new_jobs.title: Multilingual Collections Project Coordinator
new_jobs.description:
About ¡WEPA! líbros®

¡WEPA! líbros® partners with schools and public libraries to expand access to authentic books in the languages their communities speak. We design curated collections around each client’s educational goals and source books internationally to bring those collections to life.

About the Role

You will own assigned collection projects from the approved client brief through the handoff to purchasing. You’ll direct and review curation, resolve gaps, track deadlines, and make sure each collection is accurate and ready to order.

We’re looking for someone with strong judgment about multilingual literature who is equally strong at moving work forward. In this remote role, you’ll keep project records current, make decisions within your scope, and communicate early when a deadline or requirement is at risk.

What You’ll Do

* Turn client goals, age levels, languages, budget, and collection priorities into clear direction for curators.
* Assign and review curation work, checking both individual titles and the balance of the collection as a whole.
* Catch and resolve issues involving age fit, genre, language, cultural relevance, ISBNs, formats, duplication, inventory, and availability.
* Curate titles directly when a project requires it.
* Maintain clear project synopses, status updates, and outstanding decisions.
* Coordinate changes and substitutions with purchasing.
* Deliver complete purchasing handoffs on time, with unresolved issues identified and addressed.
* Communicate directly with clients about collection direction and approvals when assigned.

What You’ll Bring

* Experience in collection development, children’s literature, school or public libraries, curriculum materials, publishing, or a related field.
* A track record of managing detailed projects and meeting deadlines without close supervision.
* The ability to review a collection against a brief and make specific, defensible corrections.
* Strong spreadsheet skills and close attention to book data.
* Clear written communication and good judgment about when to act, collaborate, or escalate.
* Reliable availability and follow\-through in a remote role.

Spanish proficiency is helpful. Experience working with multilingual collections is welcome, but the ability to manage collection quality and project execution is essential.

This is a part\-time W\-2 position with scheduled weekly availability.

Job Type: Contract

Pay: $22\.00 \- $27\.00 per hour

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule

Application Question(s):

* A collection is due to purchasing on Friday. On Wednesday, you discover that several books do not meet the client’s grade\-level requirements, and the curator’s list is incomplete. You have other projects due that week. In 150 words or fewer, tell us what you would do before the end of Wednesday, what you would communicate, and how you would protect the Friday handoff.

Work Location: Remote

new_jobs.title: Experienced Medical Billing ACCOUNT MANAGER- For Remote position
new_jobs.description:
Join a growing medical billing and healthcare technology company that is transforming how physician practices manage their revenue cycles. We provide credentialing and comprehensive revenue cycle management (RCM) services to physician practices nationwide, combining innovative technology with responsive, hands\-on support. As our company and client base continue to expand, this is an exciting opportunity to join a collaborative, fast\-paced team where your expertise will make a meaningful impact and you will have opportunities to grow professionally and advance your career.

The RCM Account Manager is responsible for the overall performance and success of assigned client accounts. This role requires professional communication with providers, clinical staff, insurance payers, patients, and internal teams. The successful candidate will bring strong critical\-thinking skills, comprehensive medical billing knowledge, and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast\-paced environment. You will monitor key performance indicators (KPIs), oversee billing workflows, and guide the billing team across charge entry, payment posting, accounts receivable, denial management, and related RCM activities.

This position serves as the primary point of contact for assigned providers and is expected to independently research and resolve complex billing, nonpayment, denial, and payer\-related issues. The Account Manager will provide attentive, hands\-on support to the billing team, clearly explain account performance and concerns to clients, and coordinate closely with the credentialing team. Participation in provider meetings related to billing, credentialing, performance, and issue resolution is required.

This is a full\-time, remote position requiring excellent organization, time management, accountability, and follow\-through. The Account Manager maintains a high\-level view of each account while remaining engaged in day\-to\-day performance. Much of the role involves reviewing KPIs, resolving outstanding items, assisting with claim denials, and partnering closely with the billing team to address complex issues and maintain strong account performance.

***Required*** **Qualifications:**

· Minimum of five years of direct experience in **professional, provider\-based medical billing** 

· At least five additional years of **experience concurrently managing multiple high\-volume client accounts**, such as large provider groups, multispecialty practices, or clients with substantial weekly or monthly encounter volumes

new_jobs.description:
Remote
Customer Experience
Remote
Full\-time
**What is Bilt?**
Bilt is the membership for where you live.  

  

What started as a way to reward people on their largest expense has turned into an ecosystem connecting our members, property managers and local merchants.
Travel, dining, fitness, everyday spend. We are building systems across payments, credit, loyalty, and commerce all at once.  

  

We run lean and move quickly. Every person here has a real impact on what gets built and how fast it happens.  

  

This role comes with real ownership and high expectations. If you prefer clearly defined lanes and structure, this will feel uncomfortable. If you want to build quickly, have a real say in what gets built, and work on products used by millions, you will likely do your best work here.
**What's the role?**
As a **Customer Support Team Member**, you will serve as the first point of contact for our members through chat support and handling support tickets. **Please note, this role will require to work a weekend schedule.** We will provide comprehensive training to ensure you are thoroughly knowledgeable about our product, enabling you to offer our members exceptional support and resolve their initial inquiries with care.  

  

**\*\*This position has a start date of November 9th, 2026\. All new hires are required to attend in\-person onboarding training in New York City for their first week (November 8\-13, 2026\). Training will continue for an additional 4 weeks and requires full\-time availability from Monday \- Friday, 9AM to 6PM ET with 100% attendance. Candidates with pre\-scheduled commitments or availability conflicts during these hours will not be eligible for this cohort.\*\***  

  

**In this role, you will…**
* Respond to member inquiries through our chat platform as the first line of support
* Handle entry\-level support tickets related to payment, loyalty, and general questions within the Bilt Rewards platform
* Triage incoming tickets, identify emerging trends, and escalate complex issues to relevant internal departments
* Document member interactions and escalate ongoing patterns to senior team members
* Collaborate remotely with internal teams and our BPO partners to address and resolve member issues effectively
* Develop a deep understanding of our products, features, and services through comprehensive training programs
* Stay updated on new product releases and enhancements to effectively communicate benefits to members as the company scales
* Maintain organization and patience while understanding the specifics of each member's needs and the unique nuances of each partner's business operations
* Adapt to diverse business models and tailor your support approach to meet individual member needs
* Provide exceptional customer service through digital channels, even when handling complex inquiries
  

  

**In terms of qualifications, we’re seeking:**
* 0\-2\+ years of professional experience in customer support, operations, or related field
* Extremely organized with strong written and verbal skills.
* A team player who’s able to learn new platforms quickly and is patient and adaptable in a fast\-paced environment.
* Driven to take on new responsibilities, with an ability to stay focused on assigned tasks.
* Strong attention to detail with the intelligence to use critical thinking for solutions. Flexibility \- We are disrupting an industry so changes to traditional processes should be expected.
* Ability to deal with extremely confidential and sensitive information.
  

  

**Benefits:**
* **Compensation** \- We offer a competitive salary with a meaningful stake in the company via equity and our performance bonus program
* **Health insurance for you (\& your loved ones) from day one** \- Enjoy a One Medical Membership, wellness stipends, family programs and more, on us. We’ve got you and your family covered from day one.
* **401k plan with a match** \- Retirement may feel more like a pipe dream than a reality but we’re here to help you get there.
* **Commuter FSAs** \- We believe the best ideas come from being together in one place. We just don’t think getting there should be so expensive.
* **Competitive PTO** \- Because we believe that working hard shouldn’t mean always working.
* **Exclusive Employee only Bilt Points** \- We give our employees unique opportunities to earn points throughout their time at Bilt.
  

  

At Bilt, we believe in transparency and we do our best to make sure the company and our candidates are on the same page as it relates to compensation. In addition to posting salary ranges for our open roles, candidates should expect to be asked about compensation expectations and requirements early on in their interview process. Our goal is to highlight when expectations and Bilt’s salary range may be out of sync, and work with the candidate to determine whether it makes sense to continue conversations.  

  

We are considering candidates with differing levels of expertise for this position. Leveling will be based upon your experience and performance in the interview process.  

  

Where a new hire falls within a range will be based on their individual skills and experience, and how these competencies compare across other employees in the same role. Bilt's bands are designed to allow for individual compensation growth within the role. As such, new hires typically start at the lower end of the range. Bilt rewards performance and outcomes \- should you join the company, you will have the opportunity to grow your salary over time.  

  

The salary range for a **Customer Support Team Member** is **$50,000 \- 55,000** and will be eligible for equity and an annual performance\-based bonus.

As a CSM, you will oversee Freedom360, our premium all\-in\-one marketing solution for financial advisors. new_jobs.title: Claims Support Supervisor - Auto Insurance
new_jobs.description:
**COMPANY OVERVIEW:**  

  

Founded in 1989, United Automobile Insurance Company is an innovative and established organization looking for a Claims Support Supervisor to join our team. Family\-owned, UAIC, is one of the largest privately held property and casualty insurance companies in the United States. The key to our growth and success is a commitment to providing quality service to our agents and customers, by providing disciplined underwriting, and strategic claims handling. Our ongoing efforts to invest substantial resources in personnel and technology are the foundation of our promise of assuring maximum efficiency and specialized operations in the industry. We are proud that our independent agents and customers have recognized our dedication by making UAIC the market leader in every state where we conduct business.  

  

***This postion offers remote work in the South East Region***  

  

**SCOPE**  

  

The Claims Support Supervisor leads licensed adjusters who provide elevated claim service, explain coverage and liability information, process first\-party claim payments, and make decisions that move insured losses toward closure. The supervisor provides operational direction, quality oversight, coaching, and escalation support while ensuring work remains within team authority. Matters requiring upper\-level investigation, complex coverage determinations, negotiation, or settlement with claimants are referred to the appropriate adjusting staff.  

  

**KEY DUTIES*** Lead, coach, and support a team of licensed fast track adjusters serving as elevated points of contact for policyholders and claimants.
* Oversee accurate processing of first payments to insureds, shops, and related parties, as well as reissuance of payments previously issued on a claim.
* Review, Approve, and guide team explanations of coverage, policy terms, claim status, liability, and next steps to ensure accuracy, consistency, and appropriate licensed\-level service.
* Review and approve payments, and letters to parties to ensure accuracy and compliance.
* Handle supervisor escalation calls and activities as needed.
* Review and approve fault ratings and coverage resolutions as needed.
* Provide oversight of coverage and liability reviews on insured losses and ensure decisions are supported by claim data, properly documented, and within assigned authority.
* Handle escalated questions and disputes beyond adjuster authority; determine when a matter requires management involvement or referral to an upper\-level adjuster.
* Audit calls, claim notes, payment activity, and decision quality for compliance with company policy, Florida DFS regulations, and documentation standards.
* Monitor productivity, quality, attendance, customer service, payment accuracy, and claim\-resolution metrics; communicate expectations and manage performance concerns.
* Conduct regular one\-on\-ones, coaching, training, and development activities; ensure licenses remain active and required training is completed on time.
* Manage daily staffing, workload, call coverage, and priorities so the team responds effectively to customer needs and moves eligible claims toward closure.
* Serve as a licensed resource for the team and entry\-level CSRs; identify trends, process gaps, and training needs and recommend operational improvements.

  

**QUALIFICATIONS**  

* High school diploma or equivalent; associate degree preferred.
* Active Florida 6\-20 All\-Lines Adjuster license in good standing is required.
* Prior P\&C insurance service or claims experience is required; UAIC experience and previous leadership or coaching experience are preferred.
* Strong communication, organization, analysis, coaching, and conflict\-resolution skills with sound independent judgment.
* Bilingual English/Spanish preferred; proficiency with claim systems, contact\-center tools, reporting, and Microsoft Office applications.

  

**BENEFITS:*** 401(k) Retirement Savings Plan with employer match.
* Comprehensive Medical, Prescription Drug, Vision, and Dental Insurance
* Paid Time Off, Holidays, and Leave programs.
* Flexible spending accounts
* Basic Life Insurance and Voluntary Life/ADD
* Short Term and Long\-Term Disability

All employment decisions at UAIC are based on business needs, job requirements, and individual qualifications, without regard to race, color, religion, or belief, family or parental status, or any other status protected by the laws or regulations in the locations where we operate.
